facts.subject: Overworld
facts.text: In the overworld view you will not be attacked.

evidence.quote: In the overworld view you will not be attacked.

facts.subject: Overworld Controls
facts.text: In overworld view, the Directional-Pad moves up, down, left, and right, the A Button talks or acquires things, and the B Button has no use.

evidence.quote:
OVERWORLD VIEW CONTROLS

    Directional-Pad: Move up, down, left, and right.
    A BUTTON: Talk or Acquire things
    B BUTTON: No use

facts.subject: Dungeon Controls
facts.text: In dungeon view, the Directional-Pad moves up, down, left, right, and diagonally, the A Button jumps, the B Button uses the current weapon, Start pauses, and Select switches weapons.

evidence.quote:
DUNGEON VIEW CONTROLS

    Directional-Pad: Move up, down, left, right, and diagonally.
    A BUTTON: JUMP
    B BUTTON: USE CURRENT WEAPON
    START: PAUSE
    SELECT: SWITCH WEAPON

facts.subject: Dr. J
facts.text: If you answer NO when asked if you understand, Dr. J will state to reverse the wording, so answer YES.

evidence.quote:
If you answer NO he will
    simply state to you the obvious that you reverse the wording so
    just say YES even though it still doesn't make sense.

facts.subject: Dimensional Gate
facts.text: Mike reads Paapaapaaoompapamowmow from the Oxford Wonder World book, which causes a dimensional gate to open and Mike to get sucked into it.

evidence.quote:
He instructs Mike to get him the 
    Oxford Wonder World book....Paapaapaaoompapamowmow is read by Mike before his
    uncle can tell him to stop. This causes the book to open and
    its pages to turn really quickly. Suddenly we see a dimensonal
    gate open and Mike get sucked into it.

facts.subject: Chapter 2: ICE AGE
facts.text: You can only head North across the snow, where a cave man warns that the ground has random holes you can fall into.

evidence.quote:
You can only 
    head North at this point so head in that direction. You will 
    find a cave man that will tell you that the ground has holes and
    to be careful. As far as I can tell these holes are random so just 
    be prepared to fall into a few of them as you cross this snow.

facts.subject: Random Dungeon A
facts.text: In Room 3 of Random Dungeon A, there are five boars, a salamander, and some rocks to grab.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are five boars here and a salamander, but most importantly 
    are some rocks. Grab the rocks and kill what you must.

facts.subject: Random Dungeon A
facts.text: Room 4 of Random Dungeon A exits back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    Exit back to overworld.

facts.subject: Random Dungeon B
facts.text: In Room 2 of Random Dungeon B, there are four boars and some rocks to grab.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are four boars here, and there are some rocks. 
    Grab the rocks and do you must to get to ROOM #3.

facts.subject: Random Dungeon B
facts.text: Room 3 of Random Dungeon B exits back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    Exit back to overworld.

facts.subject: Random Dungeon C
facts.text: In Room 2 of Random Dungeon C, there are two boars and some rocks to grab.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are two boars here, and there are some rocks. 
    Grab the rocks and do you must to get to ROOM #3.

facts.subject: Random Dungeon C
facts.text: In Room 3 of Random Dungeon C, there are no enemies, just hearts to collect while being careful not to fall in the water.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are no enemies here. Just hearts to collect. Be
    careful to not fall in the water.

facts.subject: Random Dungeon C
facts.text: In Room 4 of Random Dungeon C, kill the blue bear with stones to open the path to Room 5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    There is a blue bear here. Quickly kill him with your
    stones and the path will open up to ROOM #5.

facts.subject: Random Dungeon C
facts.text: Room 5 of Random Dungeon C exits back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    Exit back to overworld.

facts.subject: Pikazo
facts.text: Visit Pikazo in Cave Men Cave and write down the drawings seen on his wall.

evidence.quote:
Make sure you 
    visit Pikazo and write down the drawings you see on his wall.

facts.subject: Tink
facts.text: Visit Tink over by a large pile of bones in Cave Men Cave to receive an Axe he has made.

evidence.quote:
Also, visit Tink over by a large pile of bones. He has an Axe
    that he has made that he will give you.

facts.subject: Prophet
facts.text: The prophet in Cave Men Cave asks if you are the one, and tells you to head to the cave and defeat Yum Yum.

evidence.quote:
Continue your way through the cave and find the prophet who
    prophesized your coming. He will ask you if you are the one.
    Regardless of what you answer he will tell you to head to the 
    cave and defeat Yum Yum.

facts.subject: Cave Men Cave
facts.text: After exiting Cave Men Cave to the overworld, continue North until you find another cave entrance.

evidence.quote:
Once you exit the cave and return to the overworld view continue
    North until you find another cave entrance.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 2 of Yum Yum Cave, defeat the 4 boars to open a wall to the North leading to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are 4 boars in here. You must defeat them and once you do a 
    wall will open to the North allowing you to ROOM #3.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 3 of Yum Yum Cave, kill the salamanders on the right to hear a wall open, then take the northern opening on the left to Room 4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are several boars in this room. Make your way to the right 
    and kill the salamanders. You will hear a wall open. If you walk 
    back to the left you will see an opening to the North. Take this 
    to ROOM #4.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 4 of Yum Yum Cave, take the medicine and go back to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    There is nothing here but a medicine. Just take it and go back to 
    ROOM #3.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 5 of Yum Yum Cave, ignore the two salamanders and continue right to Room 6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    There are two salamanders here but ignore them continuing right to 
    ROOM #6.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 6 of Yum Yum Cave, ignore the four boars and go north to Room 7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    There are four boars here but ignore them as well and go north to 
    ROOM #7.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 7 of Yum Yum Cave, jump to the little island and jump south until making your way back to Room 6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    There are four boars here but ignore them as well and go north to 
    ROOM #7.

ROOM #7:
    There is a blue bear that you should kill quickly. You can ignore it 
    however and proceed to jump to the little island and then head jump 
    south until we make our way back to ROOM #6.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: From Room 7, move around the corners of Room 6 and Room 5 until reaching Room 8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6 & #5 (from ROOM #7):
    Just move around the corners of these rooms until you make your way 
    to ROOM #8.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 8 of Yum Yum Cave, jump across ledges to the far left, killing two boars along the way, then proceed left and go north to Room 9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    There are four boars here but ignore the two on the bottom. You need 
    to jump across these ledges until you make it all the way to the far 
    left. Killing two boars along the way.Proceed left and go north to 
    ROOM #9.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 9 of Yum Yum Cave, defeat the three blue bears to open the door North to Room 11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    There are three blue bears that you need to defeat to open the door 
    to the North. Once you have defeated them you can go North to ROOM 
    #11.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 10 of Yum Yum Cave, there are three boars, and you proceed North to Room 11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    There are just three boars here. You can kill them if you wish but 
    in either case proceed North to ROOM #11.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 11 of Yum Yum Cave, head right past the walking snow men to find a room going North to Room 12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    There are several walking snow men in this room. Head right, you 
    don't have to defeat the snow men but it is easier if you do. 
    Eventually you will see a room going North to ROOM #12.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 12 of Yum Yum Cave, defeat the yellow bear if you must and continue North to Room 13.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12:
    This room has a yellow bear in it. Defeat it if you must and then 
    continue North to ROOM #13.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 13 of Yum Yum Cave, defeat the three yellow bears to open the door to the North leading to Room 14.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    This room has three yellow bears. In this room you must defeat them 
    to open the door to the North taking you to ROOM #14.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 14 of Yum Yum Cave, follow the exits matching the drawing sequence: circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #14:
    This is the maze section and the reason I asked you to scribble down 
    the drawings on the wall back at the cave men cave. If you didn't 
    write it down it was: circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, 
    square, triangle. Just follow the exit to the room closest to the 
    symbol and you should get through this maze no problem.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 15 of Yum Yum Cave, proceed to the East past the four snow men to enter Room 16.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #15:
    There are four snow men in this room but you can skip them if you'd 
    like and proceed to the East and taking you to ROOM #16.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: In Room 16 of Yum Yum Cave, there are six boars, and you proceed North to Room 17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #16:
    There are just six boars here. You can kill them if you wish but in 
    either case proceed North to ROOM #17.

facts.subject: Yum Yum
facts.text: Yum Yum goes down after about 30 axes while avoiding the burped bubbles, opening the door East to Room 18.

evidence.quote:
If you do have to battle with him just make sure to avoid the 
    bubbles he burps at you and keep throwing axes his way. He should go 
    down after about 30 axes and the door to the East and Room #18 will 
    open up.

facts.subject: Yum Yum
facts.text: Do not attack the boar next to Yum Yum, because Yum Yum will eat the boar and continue to ignore you, but attacking it will make him engage immediately.

evidence.quote:
Do not attack the boar that is 
    next to him. Yum Yum will eat this boar and continue to ignore you, 
    but if you kill this boar he will immediately engage you in combat.

Make sure you don't kill the 
pig though, because...then he gets really angry and actually does something.

facts.subject: Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: Room 18 of Yum Yum Cave has an exit to the North.

evidence.quote:
Room #18:
    There is an exit to the North.

facts.subject: Back of Yum Yum Cave
facts.text: Head North and East in the cave to pick up a Block that is one of the mystic tetrads, which also increases your life total to seven hearts.

evidence.quote:
Continue North and then East until you 
    find a Block and then proceed out of the cave....Mike then 
    realizes the Block he just picked up in the cave is one of these 
    tetrads. As a bonus you increase your life total to seven hearts.

facts.subject: Time Travel
facts.text: Mike recites PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW from the Oxford World Wonder to flip pages and travel to another time period.

evidence.quote:
Unsure what to do now, Mike consults the Oxford World Wonder again. 
    Mike recites the words:
    PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW. 
    This flips the pages again and sends Mike to another time period.

facts.subject: ROOM #5
facts.text: ROOM #5 has 5 floating jellyfish and a lone frog in the middle, which can be killed or jumped around to reach ROOM #6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    This room has 5 floating jellyfish and a lone frog in the middle. 
    You can kill them or just skillfully jump around them to ROOM #6.

facts.subject: ROOM #6
facts.text: In ROOM #6 are two swans, three jellyfish, and a hippopotamus, none of which have to be killed to reach ROOM #7 to the North.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    In this room are two swans and three jellyfish. There is also a 
    hippopotamus but you don't have to kill any of them to get to the 
    ROOM #7 to the North.

facts.subject: ROOM #7
facts.text: ROOM #7 leads back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    Exit back to overworld.

facts.subject: Monkey Savannah
facts.text: An ASCII map displays the layout and paths for MONKEY MAZE PART #3.

evidence.quote:
- - - M O N K E Y  M A Z E  P A R T # 3 - - -

facts.subject: Monkey Maze Part #3
facts.text: To navigate Monkey Maze Part #3, move down and to the left, up the West side of the map, and then back East along the Northern part of the map to exit out on the Northern edge.

evidence.quote:
Move down and to the left and then up
    the West side of the map. Then go back East along the Northern part
    of the map. Eventually you will make it out on the Northern edge

facts.subject: psychic shock wave
facts.text: At a small mountain range, the monkey shows Mike how to do a psychic shock wave before Mike is teleported back to the Pyramid and Sphinx.

evidence.quote:
make your way to a small mountain range where that monkey 
    (Merlin?!?) will show you how to do a psychic shock wave. Then you 
    will be teleported back to the Pyramid and Sphinx.

facts.subject: Pyramid
facts.text: An ASCII map outlines the 26 rooms and layout of the Pyramid.

evidence.quote:
=======
    PYRAMID
    =======

    LEGEND FOR PYRAMID
    1 = Starting Point for Pyramid

facts.subject: ROOM #1
facts.text: In ROOM #1, jumping on the middle tile in the group of tiles to the left makes two hearts appear.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    If you are low on hearts you can jump on the middle tile in the 
    group of tiles to the left and two hearts will appear.

facts.subject: ROOM #1
facts.text: Head North from ROOM #1 to reach ROOM #2.

evidence.quote:
In either 
    case, head North to ROOM #2.

facts.subject: force field
facts.text: The force field in ROOM #2 requires the Psychic Shockwave to destroy before continuing North to ROOM #3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    This force field requires the Psychic Shockwave to destroy. Dispose 
    of the field and continue to the North to ROOM #3.

facts.subject: ROOM #3
facts.text: ROOM #3 contains three ladybugs that must be disposed of to open the door West to ROOM #4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are three ladybugs in here. Dispose of the them and the door 
    will open to the West to ROOM #4.

facts.subject: ROOM #4
facts.text: In ROOM #4, stairs in the upper left corner lead to ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    There are two asps in here. Dispose of the them if you want to or 
    just take the stairs in the upper left corner of the room to 
    ROOM #5.

facts.subject: ROOM #5
facts.text: In ROOM #5, stop after passing the first flame and jump over that part of the floor, or you will fall back to the floor below with the asps.

evidence.quote:
Once you
    pass this first flame STOP. If you proceed any farther you will fall 
    back to the floor below with the asps. Instead jump over this part 
    of the floor.

facts.subject: ROOM #5
facts.text: In ROOM #5, jump on one of the tiles in the top group to reveal a question mark at the bottom of the room, which opens the East door to ROOM #6 when grabbed.

evidence.quote:
Now go up to the top group of tiles and jump on one of the 
    tiles to reveal the question mark at the bottom of the room. Jump 
    over the spikes and flames to get to the bottom of the room and once 
    you grab the question mark the door to the East will open.

facts.subject: ROOM #5
facts.text: There are two hearts located on the north side of ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
There are 
    two hearts on the north side of the room, get them if you'd like and 
    then go East to ROOM #6.

facts.subject: ROOM #7
facts.text: In ROOM #7, defeating the mummy and mini-mummy and hopping on a tile reveals a question mark that opens the chest to reveal a medicine container.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    When you first enter this room you will see a mummy and mini-mummy. 
    Take both of them out and then hop on one of the tiles to reveal the 
    question mark. Get this mark to open the chest and reveal a medicine
    container.

facts.subject: ROOM #7
facts.text: In ROOM #7, jump to the right side of the room to take the door South to ROOM #8.

evidence.quote:
Get the medicine and jump to the right side of this room. There are 
    two more mini mummies you can choose to defeat before taking the 
    door to the South to ROOM #8.

facts.subject: Aman-Ra guardian
facts.text: Defeating the one Aman-Ra guardian in ROOM #8 opens the door East to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    Inside this room is one Aman-Ra guardian. Just take your time and 
    defeat him to open the door and head East to ROOM #9.

facts.subject: ROOM #9
facts.text: In ROOM #9, fall through the false floors in the middle of the circular pattern of tiles to get to ROOM #10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    All that is in this room are a circular pattern of tiles. In the 
    middle of these tiles are false floors which you need to fall 
    through to get to ROOM #10.

facts.subject: ROOM #10
facts.text: Press the control pad to the left while falling into ROOM #10, or you will land on another false floor and plunge down to ROOM #11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    As you fall into this room press your control pad to the left. If 
    you don't you will land on another false floor and plunge down to 
    ROOM #11.

facts.subject: ROOM #10
facts.text: In ROOM #10, a pair of two hearts is located in the bottom left corner of the room.

evidence.quote:
When you do manage to reach ROOM #10 without falling 
    through you will see a pair of two hearts in the bottom left corner 
    of the room.

facts.subject: ROOM #10
facts.text: From ROOM #10, head East while avoiding the metal ball moving in a circular pattern to reach ROOM #12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10: ... Get them if you need them otherwise head to the East 
    (avoiding the metal ball that is moving in a circular pattern) into 
    ROOM #12.

facts.subject: ROOM #11
facts.text: ROOM #11 contains four skeletons, with stairs in the upper right corner leading to ROOM #10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    There is nothing in this room except four skeletons. Dispose of the 
    them if you want to or just take the stairs in the upper right 
    corner of the room to ROOM #10.

facts.subject: ROOM #12
facts.text: Defeating both the pyramid guardian and the asp on the directional conveyor belt in ROOM #12 opens the door East to ROOM #13.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12:
    Inside this room a directional conveyor belt with a pyramid 
    guardian and an asp. You can use the conveyor belt if you need to 
    but just focus on defeating both enemies to open the door and head 
    East to ROOM #13.

facts.subject: ROOM #13
facts.text: In ROOM #13, jump up the columns on the right and jump left to the column with tiles, then jump on a tile to reveal a question mark that opens the wall East to ROOM #14.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    There are four skeletons and one metal ball. Avoid them and head to 
    the right side of the room and jump up on the columns and head back 
    left jumping until you come to the column with the tiles. Jump on 
    one of these tiles to make the question mark appear. Jump down and 
    grab this mark which will open the wall to the East to ROOM #14.

facts.subject: ROOM #14
facts.text: In ROOM #14, defeating the mummy near Mike, the ladybugs in the middle, and the remaining mummy opens the door North to ROOM #15.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #14:
    Immediately upon entering this room dispose of the mummy nearby 
    Mike. Then jump over the spikes and defeat the ladybugs in the 
    middle of the room. Take out the remaining mummy and the door to 
    the North will open to ROOM #15.

facts.subject: ROOM #14
facts.text: ROOM #14 contains a life sign.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #14: ... There is also a life sign in here 
    if you want to try your luck.

facts.subject: ROOM #15
facts.text: Defeating the two Aman-Ra guardians in ROOM #15 opens the door North to ROOM #16.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #15:
    Inside this room are two Aman-Ra guardians. Just take your time and 
    defeat them to open the door North to ROOM #16.

facts.subject: spiders
facts.text: In ROOM #16, ride the middle conveyor belt around to defeat each of the spiders on the ledges to open the door North to ROOM #17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #16:
    When you enter this room you will see spikes along the outside of 
    the room with a conveyor in the middle. You must go around on this 
    conveyor and defeat each of the spiders on the ledges to open the 
    door North to ROOM #17.

facts.subject: ROOM #17
facts.text: In ROOM #17, defeating the three ladybugs opens the door West to ROOM #18, and jumping on a middle tile reveals two hearts.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #17:
    Inside this room are three ladybugs. After you defeat them to open 
    the door West to ROOM #18 you can jump on a tile in the middle to 
    reveal two hearts if you need them.

facts.subject: ROOM #18
facts.text: ROOM #18 contains two mini mummies and two pyramid guardians whose defeat opens the door North to ROOM #19.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #18:
    This room contains two mini mummies and two pyramid guardians. 
    Defeat them to open the door North to ROOM #19.

facts.subject: ROOM #19
facts.text: In ROOM #19, jumping on the tail tile of the snake-like tile pattern reveals a question mark that opens the door East to ROOM #20.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #19:
    No enemies here, just a pattern of tiles that resembles a snake. 
    Jump on the tail tile to reveal the question mark. Grabbing this 
    mark opens the door East to ROOM #20.

facts.subject: ROOM #20
facts.text: Defeating the two mummies in ROOM #20 opens the door East to ROOM #21.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #20:
    This room contains two mummies. Defeat them to open the door East 
    to ROOM #21.

facts.subject: ROOM #21
facts.text: In ROOM #21, jumping on a tile at the top of the room reveals medicine, and defeating the one Aman-Ra guardian opens the door South to ROOM #22.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #21:
    There is one Aman-Ra guardian in here. Defeat him to open the door 
    South to ROOM #22. There is a tile at the top of the room you can 
    jump on to make a medicine appear so don't forget that.

facts.subject: ROOM #22
facts.text: In ROOM #22, activating the tile and grabbing the question mark reveals a flute from inside the chest.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22:
    There are four mini mummies in here and a tile. Activate the tile 
    and get the question mark to reveal a flute from inside the chest. 
    Grab the flute

facts.subject: ROOM #22
facts.text: Defeating the four mini mummies in ROOM #22 opens a wall to the West leading back to ROOM #17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22: ... Grab the flute and defeat the mini mummies to open a wall to the 
    West taking you back to ROOM #17.

facts.subject: flute
facts.text: In ROOM #19, playing the flute makes three asps appear, and defeating all three opens a wall to the North leading into ROOM #23.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #19 (Revisited):
    Now that you have the flute use a flute to make three asps appear. 
    Defeat all three and a wall to the North will open up allowing you 
    to enter ROOM #23.

facts.subject: ROOM #23
facts.text: ROOM #23 has no enemies and leads North to ROOM #24.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #23:
    Nothing here so just take the door North to ROOM #24.

facts.subject: ROOM #24
facts.text: ROOM #24 has two hearts and a medicine in the left corner across the floating tiles.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #24:
    There is a mummy and mini mummy here with another floating tile out 
    in the middle to jump to. Defeat the mummies and jump across the 
    tiles to the left until you make it to the other side. There are 
    two hearts here is you want them and also another medicine over on 
    the left corner of the room.

facts.subject: ROOM #24
facts.text: From ROOM #24, take the path to the North to reach ROOM #25.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #24: ... There are two more mummies and a mini 
    mummy on the left which you can defeat or just simply take the path 
    to the North and ROOM #25.

facts.subject: PHAROAH
facts.text: The PHAROAH boss floats in the top part of the room shooting a spray of 5 bullets and occasional skeleton-face shots, moving faster and turning red as damaged.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #25: BOSS: PHAROAH

    You enter a room that has the bottom half covered in conveyors that 
    force you back to the bottom wall. The room is separated in half by 
    a guard rail. The top part of the room is where the boss float 
    around. This mask mostly shoots a spray of 5 bullets which are 
    usually pretty easy to avoid. Occasionally the mask will reveal a 
    skeleton face and shoot a more powerful shot so avoid those. As you 
    damage the mask more and more it will move faster and eventually 
    turn red.

facts.subject: ROOM #25
facts.text: Defeating PHAROAH opens a door to the East leading to ROOM #26.

evidence.quote:
Once you have defeated him a door will open to your East
    allowing you on to ROOM #26.

facts.subject: ROOM #26
facts.text: In ROOM #26, take the exit to the North.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #26:
    Exit room. Just take the exit to the North.

facts.subject: Tetrad
facts.text: Following the long narrow tunnel North inside the pyramid leads to a room where Mike obtains another Tetrad.

evidence.quote:
Back inside of the pyramid Mike sees a long narrow tunnel to his 
    North. Follow this until you enter a room with another Tetrad. 
    After Mike obtains his latest Tetrad he reads again the words: 
    PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW.

facts.subject: Sherlock Holmes
facts.text: In Scotland Yard, Sherlock Holmes tells Mike that Zoda-X will be at the museum tonight and to meet him there at midnight.

evidence.quote:
This looks 
    to be Sherlock Holmes' stomping ground. In fact once you walk 
    around a bit you will eventually bump into him. He tells you that a 
    fella named Zoda-X will be at the museum tonight and to meet him 
    there at midnight.

Sherlock Holmes: Ah... Good evening. Allow me to introduce myself... The name 
is Holmes....In fact, I have 
concluded that a robbery will occur in the museum tonight. A rascal by the name 
of Zoda-X intends to steal a most curious stone....Sherlock Holmes: Oh? Well then you shall help me catch him red-handed. Meet me 
at the museum at the stroke of midnight. And... Don't be late!

facts.subject: police officer
facts.text: Talking to a police officer in London results in Mike being put in jail.

evidence.quote:
continue along until you find one of London's finest police 
    officers. Talk to him and he will put you in jail

facts.subject: jail
facts.text: Examining the East wall inside the jail reveals an escape route leading back outside.

evidence.quote:
Turns out if you look along the 
    East wall you will find an escape. Take this to get back outside.

facts.subject: Scotland Yard
facts.text: Outside the jail, head North and West between two buildings, pass the sleep walker, and continue North to reach the museum.

evidence.quote:
Now that you are outside head North and the West until you come 
    between two building. Pass through them and say hello to the sleep 
    walker as you pass him in the night. Continue along North until 
    you find the museum and Holmes waiting for you.

facts.subject: BIG HEART
facts.text: On the streets of London, head left and descend the open manhole to obtain a BIG HEART.

evidence.quote:
When you see Mike 
    again on the streets of London have him head left to the open 
    manhole. There is a BIG HEART below that Mike could really use.

facts.subject: sewer dungeon
facts.text: After exiting the first manhole, enter the other manhole to the South to begin the sewer dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Once you have the BIG HEART go back up the manhole and then look 
    for the other manhole South of there. Take this down to start the 
    sewer dungeon.

facts.subject: LONDON SEWERS
facts.text: London Sewers map layout connects Room 1 through Room 13, with Room 12 containing Boss Zoda's Blob and Room 13 leading to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR LONDON SEWERS
    1 = Starting Point for London Sewers
    12 = BOSS: Zoda's Blob
    13 = Leads to Overworld

facts.subject: ROOM #1
facts.text: From ROOM #1, head North to ROOM #2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Just a usual entrance. Head North to ROOM #2.

facts.subject: ROOM #2
facts.text: In ROOM #2, hop on the log raft and go to the tile in the upper right part of the room to activate a question mark that opens the door North to ROOM #3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    No enemies here just a log raft floating back and forth. Hop on the 
    raft and go to the tile in the upper right part of the room. This 
    will activate the question mark which once you grab opens the door 
    to the North and ROOM #3.

facts.subject: ROOM #3
facts.text: In ROOM #3 with five yellow jellyfish, hop over the water to the right and either take the passage North to ROOM #4 or jump back left to take the passageway North to ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    This room has five yellow jellyfish. You can defeat them if you 
    want, but either way hop over the water to the right and then either 
    take the passage to the North to ROOM #4 or jump back to the left to 
    take the passageway to the North to ROOM #5.

facts.subject: ROOM #4
facts.text: In ROOM #4, defeat all three rats and three blue blobs to open a room to the West taking you to ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    There are three rats and three blue blobs in this room. Defeat all 
    of them and a room will open to the West taking you to ROOM #5.

facts.subject: ROOM #5
facts.text: In ROOM #5, activate the tile on the upper left part of the room and get the question mark to open the wall North leading to ROOM #6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    This room has four red frogs hopping around. You don't have to 
    defeat them but it will help you reach the tile on the upper left 
    part of the room. Once you activate it and get the question
    mark the wall to the North will open leading you to ROOM #6.

facts.subject: ROOM #6
facts.text: In ROOM #6, defeat the two large rats to cause the North wall to open to ROOM #7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    There are two large rats in this room. Defeating them causes the 
    North wall to open to ROOM #7.

facts.subject: ROOM #7
facts.text: In ROOM #7, grab the medicine, then retrace your steps to ROOM #6, ROOM #5, and South to ROOM #3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    There is nothing here but a medicine. Grab it and retrace your 
    steps to ROOM #6, then ROOM #5 and then South from ROOM #5 to 
    ROOM #3.

facts.subject: ROOM #3 (Revisited)
facts.text: When revisiting ROOM #3, hop on one of the tiles to your right to reveal the question mark which opens the gate West to ROOM #8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3 (Revisited):
    When you first enter you will notice some tiles to your right. Hop 
    on one of them to reveal the question mark which when you grab 
    will open the gate to the West and ROOM #8.

facts.subject: ROOM #8
facts.text: In ROOM #8, follow the path back and forth between ROOM #8 and ROOM #9 with three small rats until reaching the door that goes West to ROOM #10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    This room has three small rats. You will follow a path between this 
    room and ROOM #9 that goes back and forth until you eventually end 
    up in this room again and a door that goes West to ROOM #10.

facts.subject: ROOM #9
facts.text: In ROOM #9, avoid or defeat the rats as you follow the path that goes back and forth between ROOM #8 and ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    As stated above you need to avoid the rats in this room and ROOM #8 
    as you go along the path that goes back and forth between these two 
    rooms. You can of course defeat them if you wish.

facts.subject: ROOM #10
facts.text: In ROOM #10, defeat the two jellyfish and two red frogs on the 4 paths with conveyor tiles to open the wall North to ROOM #11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    In this room are two jellyfish and two red frogs. There are also 4 
    paths with conveyor tiles on each path in different directions. 
    Defeat all the enemies in this room to open the wall to the North 
    and ROOM #11. Remember that these conveyor tiles can push you off 
    the path into the water.

facts.subject: ROOM #11
facts.text: In ROOM #11, defeat the three owls to open the door North to ROOM #12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    This room has three owls in it. Defeat them and the door to the 
    North will open to ROOM #12.

facts.subject: Zoda's Blob
facts.text: In ROOM #12, defeat Zoda's Blob by continuously hopping around the ball without staying on one tile for too long, then jump on one of the tiles it was on to get the question mark opening the door East to ROOM #13.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12: BOSS: Zoda's Blob
    Inside of this room is Zoda. He creates some sort of weird ball. 
    Just hop around the ball until you defeat it. Don't sit on one
    tile for two long. You must keep moving to defeat this blob. Then 
    jump on one of the tiles that it was on to get the question mark 
    which opens the door to the East and ROOM #13.

facts.subject: ROOM #13
facts.text: ROOM #13 exits back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    Exit back to the overworld.

facts.subject: LONDON SEWERS 2
facts.text: London Sewers 2 map layout connects Room 1 through Room 22, with Room 21 featuring Boss Zoda X and Room 22 leading to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR LONDON SEWERS 2
    1 = Starting Point for London Sewers 2
    21 = BOSS: Zoda X
    22 = Leads to Overworld

facts.subject: ROOM #1
facts.text: In ROOM #1, there are two hearts to the left and two pairs of two hearts to the right if you jump on the tiles that way, otherwise head North to ROOM #2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    There are two hearts if you need them to the left. There are also 
    two more pairs of two hearts to the right if you jump on the tiles 
    that way. Otherwise head North to ROOM #2.

facts.subject: spiked frisbees
facts.text: In ROOM #2, defeat the three Zoda spawns and jump on the tile to open the chest to obtain spiked frisbees, then head West to ROOM #3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are three Zoda spawns in this room. Defeat them and jump on 
    the tile to open the chest to obtain spiked frisbees. After 
    acquiring this head to the West and ROOM #3.

facts.subject: ROOM #3
facts.text: In ROOM #3, defeat the two large rats to open the door South to ROOM #4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    Just two large rats in here. Defeat them to open the door to the 
    South and ROOM #4.

facts.subject: ROOM #4
facts.text: In ROOM #4, defeating the two owls opens the wall South to ROOM #5, and a tile opens the door West to ROOM #6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    This room has two small rats and two owls. When you defeat the owls 
    the wall to the South will open revealing ROOM #5. There is also a 
    tile in this room that will open the door to the West and ROOM #6.

facts.subject: medicine
facts.text: In ROOM #5, jump on the tile on the left side to open the chest containing medicine, then head back to ROOM #4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    Jump on the tile on the left side to open the chest which has 
    medicine inside. Collect this and then head back to ROOM #4.

facts.subject: ROOM #6
facts.text: In ROOM #6, keep heading left across carefully timed jumps to reach the exit South to ROOM #7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    This room has no enemies but a lot of carefully timed jumps. Keep 
    heading to the left and eventually you will see an exit to the 
    South and ROOM #7.

facts.subject: ROOM #7
facts.text: In ROOM #7, defeat the two caterpillars to open the door South to ROOM #8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    There are two caterpillars in here that once defeated will open the 
    door South to ROOM #8.

facts.subject: ROOM #8
facts.text: In ROOM #8, dispose of the four blue blobs to open the door East to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    There are four blue blobs in this room. Dispose of them and the 
    door to the East will open to ROOM #9.

facts.subject: ROOM #9
facts.text: In ROOM #9, activate the mark on the tile in the middle group to open the wall South to ROOM #10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    There are three sets of tiles. Look for the tile in the middle 
    group to activate a mark. Grab the mark and the wall to the South 
    will open to ROOM #10.

facts.subject: medicine
facts.text: In ROOM #10, jump on the tile on the left side to open the chest which has medicine inside, then head back to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    Jump on the tile on the left side to open the chest which has 
    medicine inside. Collect this and then head back to ROOM #9.

facts.subject: ROOM #9: (Revisited)
facts.text: In ROOM #9 (Revisited), fall through the floor in the middle of one of the tiles to drop down to ROOM #11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9: (Revisited):
    You will need to fall through the floor in the middle of one of 
    these tiles. This will allow you to fall to ROOM #11.

facts.subject: ROOM #11
facts.text: In ROOM #11, head North to ROOM #12, or take the West path to ROOM #13 from the left path, the East path to ROOM #14 from the right path, or the South path to ROOM #16 from the middle path.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    In this room are three vertical rows. You can head North to ROOM 
    #12. If you landed on the left path you can also take the path West 
    to ROOM #13. If you landed on the right path you can also take the 
    path East to ROOM #14. If you landed on the middle path you can 
    also take the path South to ROOM #16.

facts.subject: ROOM #12
facts.text: In ROOM #12, each path ends in a ladder to the North that takes you upstairs to ROOM #15.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12:
    Each path ends in a ladder to the North. If you take any of these 
    ladders they will take you back upstairs to ROOM #15.

facts.subject: ROOM #13
facts.text: In ROOM #13, defeat all Zoda spawns, collect two hearts, and locate the mark to open the door East back to ROOM #11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    If you can't tell by the pattern of the tiles (the pattern is a 
    skull) that this is a dead end. After you defeat all the Zoda spawns 
    you can grab two hearts and eventually you should also find the mark 
    to open the door to the East back to ROOM #11.

facts.subject: ROOM #14
facts.text: In ROOM #14, defeat the three Zoda spawns, jump across the water to defeat the blue blob, and take the path South to ROOM #17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #14:
    This room has three Zoda spawns and one blue blob on the other side 
    of the water. After defeating the spawns you need to jump across and 
    defeat the blob. Then take the path South to ROOM #17.

facts.subject: ROOM #15
facts.text: In ROOM #15, find a tile to open the wall South taking you back to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #15:
    There are four blue blobs hopping around in this room. Dispose of 
    the if you wish and look for a tile to open the wall to the South 
    taking you back to ROOM #9.

facts.subject: ROOM #16
facts.text: In ROOM #16, defeat the five small rats to open the wall East to ROOM #17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #16:
    There are five small rats. Defeat them and the wall will open to 
    East and ROOM #17.

facts.subject: ROOM #17
facts.text: In ROOM #17, defeat the two caterpillars to open the door South to ROOM #18.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #17:
    Two caterpillars are in here and once defeated the door to the 
    South open to ROOM #18.

facts.subject: spiked frisbees
facts.text: In ROOM #18, jump between rafts to find two hearts, spiked frisbees, and a life sign, then find the exit South to ROOM #19.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #18:
    You need to jump from raft to raft here. There are also two hearts 
    and some more spiked frisbees in here. You can also get the life 
    sign if you feel lucky. Once you make it around the rafts you should 
    see an exit to the South and ROOM #19.

facts.subject: ROOM #19
facts.text: In ROOM #19, defeat the four Zoda spawns to open the wall East to ROOM #20, and activate the switch to open the door West to boss ROOM #21.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #19:
    There are four Zoda spawns in here. Defeat them and then the wall 
    to the East will open to ROOM #20. You can also activate the switch 
    to open the door to the West and ROOM #21 but this is where the BOSS 
    is so do ROOM #20 first.

facts.subject: medicine
facts.text: In ROOM #20, get the medicine and head back West to ROOM #19.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #20:
    There is a medicine in here. Get it and then head back West to ROOM 
    #19 avoiding enemies or defeating them as necessary.

facts.subject: Zoda X
facts.text: In ROOM #21, avoid Zoda X's spread of shots and ring of fire while navigating conveyor belts, hitting him when visible to defeat him and unlock the door North to ROOM #22.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #21: BOSS: Zoda X

    This Zoda boss is harder than most bosses. The room is full of
    conveyor belts going in multiple directions so you will have trouble
    walking in a straight line. Zoda X will appear in random locations
    and either shoot a spread of shots or make a ring of fire. Avoid
    both the shots and the fire as best as possible and just keep 
    trying to hit him when he becomes visible and eventually he'll go 
    down. Defeat him and take the door to the North ROOM #22.

facts.subject: ROOM #22
facts.text: ROOM #22 is the exit back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22:
    This is the exit back to the overworld.

facts.subject: tetrad
facts.text: Back in the overworld, walk the sewers until you find another tetrad.

evidence.quote:
Back in the overworld you keep walking the sewers until you find 
    another tetrad.

facts.subject: Mike
facts.text: After speaking with Holmes, Mike says the magic words 'PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW' to flip the pages and travel to another time period.

evidence.quote:
Then take the ladder you'll find Holmes who deduces 
    that there must be a Zoda-Y and Zoda-Z as well. You thank Holmes for 
    his help and then say the magic words:
    PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW. 
    This flips the pages again and sends Mike to another time period.

facts.subject: piano player
facts.text: In the saloon in DESERT TOWN, talk to the piano player and pay attention to the tune he sings, as it will be used later in the chapter.

evidence.quote:
In the saloon you will want to talk to 
    the piano player. Pay attention to the tune he sings you will use 
    this tune later in this chapter.

facts.subject: shopkeeper
facts.text: In the shop in the Northern part of DESERT TOWN, talk to the shopkeeper who gives a clue about where to go next.

evidence.quote:
Make sure you go to the shop in 
    the Northern part of the town. He will give you a clue to where to 
    go next.

facts.subject: dynamite
facts.text: Go to Bob's store in DESERT TOWN and Bob will give you dynamite.

evidence.quote:
Make your way back to Bob's store and he will now give you 
    some dynamite.

facts.subject: dynamite
facts.text: Follow the line of lighter shade rocks towards the mountain ridge and lay dynamite there to open up caves containing gold and chicken nuggets.

evidence.quote:
You should see some rocks that are
    a lighter shade forming a line towards the ridge. Follow this line 
    and lay the dynamite there. This will open up caves that you can 
    find gold and chicken nuggets in.

facts.subject: BIG HEART
facts.text: Place dynamite between the two large boulders next to the ridge to reveal a cave door with a BIG HEART in it.

evidence.quote:
You will also see two large 
    boulders next to the ridge. Place a load of dynamite in between 
    these to reveal a cave door with a BIG HEART in it.

facts.subject: gold piece
facts.text: If you collect the gold piece, Bob at the store will offer to purchase it for points before it is lost at the start of the next chapter.

evidence.quote:
Go back and get 
    more dynamite and if you collected the gold piece Bob will offer to 
    purchase your gold. All it does is give you points so it is 
    completely optional if you want to sell it to him or not. I would
    recommend it however because otherwise you will lose that gold at
    the start of the next chapter.

facts.subject: cave
facts.text: Place dynamite a few spaces below the cave where you obtained the gold nugget to reveal the cave you need to enter next.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the ridge and place 
    dynamite a few spaces below the cave that you got the gold nugget. 
    This will reveal the cave you need to go next.

facts.subject: MINING CAVE
facts.text: Mining Cave map layout connects Room 1 through Room 13, with Room 12 containing Boss Mining Cyclops and Room 13 serving as the exit to overworld.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR MINING CAVE
    1 = Starting Point for Mining Cave
    12 = BOSS: Mining Cyclops
    13 = Exit to Overworld

facts.subject: ROOM #1
facts.text: From ROOM #1, head North to ROOM #2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Just a usual entrance. Head North to ROOM #2.

facts.subject: ROOM #2
facts.text: In ROOM #2, defeat the three blue scorpions to head North to Room #3 or West to ROOM #4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are three blue scorpions in here. Defeat them and head North 
    to Room #3 or West to ROOM #4.

facts.subject: ROOM #3
facts.text: In ROOM #3, defeat the two blue asps and head back to ROOM #2 and then ROOM #4 since the other side of the wall cannot be accessed yet.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    This room has two blue asps. After you defeat them you will notice 
    there is more to this room on the other side of the wall. Nothing 
    you can do now so head back to ROOM #2 and then ROOM #4.

facts.subject: ROOM #4
facts.text: In ROOM #4, defeat the two cactus guys and shoot the crack in the North wall to open the wall to ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    This room has four tiles and two cactus guys. Defeat the cactus 
    guys and then shoot the crack in the wall to the North. This opens 
    the wall to ROOM #5.

facts.subject: ROOM #5
facts.text: ROOM #5 has a ladder going up to ROOM #6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    This room simply has a ladder going up to ROOM #6.

facts.subject: ROOM #6
facts.text: In ROOM #6, jump back and forth between three horizontal paths to avoid rolling boulders and make your way East to ROOM #7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    Inside of this room are three horizontal paths to the right. On 
    each of these paths is a rolling boulder. Just jump back and forth 
    between these paths to avoid the boulder make your way to the East 
    and eventually the door and ROOM #7.

facts.subject: ROOM #7
facts.text: In ROOM #7, jump to the floating tile in the middle of the tiles to fall through the false floor down to the other side of Room #3.

evidence.quote:
There is a floating tile in the middle of the tiles. If 
    you jump to this you will fall through the false floor down to the 
    other side of Room #3.

facts.subject: ROOM #3 (revisited)
facts.text: When falling into ROOM #3 from ROOM #7, defeat the two cactus guys to open the door South to ROOM #8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3 (revisited):
    If you fell from ROOM #7 you will find two cactus guys which you 
    must defeat to open the door to the South and ROOM #8.

facts.subject: ROOM #8
facts.text: In ROOM #8, activate the tile on the South end to reveal a question mark that opens the door South to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    There are two blue asps and two blue scorpions in here. You don't 
    have to defeat them but it makes it much easier to activate the 
    tile on the South end of the room. This will reveal a question mark
    which after you get will open the door to the South to ROOM #9.

facts.subject: slingshot
facts.text: In ROOM #9, defeat the treasure chest enemies to open the wall South to ROOM #10, and optionally pick up the slingshot inside the normal treasure chest.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    This room has the treasure chest enemies. Defeat them to open the 
    wall to the South and ROOM #10. There is also a normal trasure 
    chest in here with a slingshot if you want to pick that up.

facts.subject: ROOM #10
facts.text: In ROOM #10, defeat the three cactus guys to open the wall South to ROOM #11, or take the passageway West to ROOM #12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    There are three cactus guys in this room who if you defeat will 
    open the wall to the South and ROOM #11. There is also a passageway 
    to the West and ROOM #12 but go to ROOM #11 first.

facts.subject: medicine
facts.text: In ROOM #11, open the chest to reveal a medicine, then head back North to ROOM #10 and West to ROOM #12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    In this room is just a chest and tiles. Open the chest to reveal a 
    medicine and then head back North to ROOM #10 and then West to ROOM 
    #12.

facts.subject: Mining Cyclops
facts.text: In ROOM #12, attack the Mining Cyclops while avoiding touching him, then jump across the floating platforms on the South side to reach ROOM #13.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12: BOSS: Mining Cyclops
    There is just a long straight pathway to a cyclops at the other end. 
    After awhile he will grab a rock to throw at you just keep hitting 
    him until he is defeated. Be careful not to touch him as he will kill 
    you instantly if you do. After you defeat him a floating platform 
    will appear on the South side of the room. Jump on this and then the 
    next and then to the corner of the room on the bottom left part of 
    the room. This will take you to ROOM #13.

facts.subject: ROOM #13
facts.text: ROOM #13 is the exit back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    This is the exit back to the overworld.

facts.subject: Donkey
facts.text: Head North to find a donkey that teaches Mike the Super Psychic Shock Wave before vanishing.

evidence.quote:
We head 
    North to find a donkey. This donkey teaches Mike the Super Psychic 
    Shock Wave. Hmm... this donkey seems kinda like the monkey in Egypt.
    He then vanishes, allowing Mike to continue forward to the next cave.

facts.subject: Mining Cave 2
facts.text: Mining Cave 2 starts at Room 1 and leads through Room 22 with boss Skeleton Miner to Room 23 which exits to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR MINING CAVE 2
    1 = Starting Point for Mining Cave 2
    22 = BOSS: Skeleton Miner
    23 = Leads to Overworld

facts.subject: Room 1
facts.text: In Room 1, starting on a tile reveals two hearts before heading North to Room 2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    There is a tile here when you start that reveals two hearts. Head 
    North to ROOM #2.

facts.subject: blue scorpions
facts.text: In Room 2, jump over to the ledge on the North wall and defeat three blue scorpions to open the door to the North and Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2: 
    You need to do some careful jumping in this room and get over to 
    the ledge on the North wall. There are three blue scorpions here 
    that after you defeat will open the door to the North and ROOM #3.

facts.subject: medicine
facts.text: In Room 3, immediately jump to your right upon entering, defeat one blue scorpion, grab the medicine, and continue North to Room 4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    Immediately jump to your right when you enter this room. There is 
    one blue scorpion to defeat and then grab the medicine. Then 
    continue North to ROOM #4.

facts.subject: conveyor
facts.text: In Room 4, let the conveyor take you North to Room 5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    Just let the conveyor take you North to ROOM #5.

facts.subject: blue scorpions
facts.text: In Room 5, jump to your left upon entering where there are three blue scorpions you can defeat before taking the left path North to Room 6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    Immediately jump to your left when you enter this room. There are 
    three blue scorpions that you can defeat if you need to defeat and 
    take the left path to the North to ROOM #6.

facts.subject: false floor
facts.text: In Room 6, arriving in the middle forces you forward through the false floor to Room 7 below, or take the lower right path South back to Room 5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    If you arrived in the middle of the room. All you can do is walk 
    forward through the false floor to ROOM #7 below. If you are not 
    in the middle then defeat the cactus guys if you want and then 
    take the lower right path to the South back to Room #5.

facts.subject: three Asps

ROOM #4 (revisited):

ROOM #9:

ROOM #12:

facts.subject: hearts
facts.text: In Room 21, avoid the spikes out of the wall and pick up the two hearts while heading North to Room 22.

ROOM #21:

facts.subject: Skeleton Miner
facts.text: In Room 22, boss Skeleton Miner smashes a large hammer into the ground causing stun, spread shots, and falling rocks; jump to avoid being stunned, shoot Stars at him, and defeat him to open the door to Room 23.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22 BOSS: Skeleton Miner
    This miner carries a large hammer that he will frequently smash

    fall onto the floor and imped Mike's ability to move around the
    room. If you jump when he smashes his hammer then you can usually
    avoid being stunned. Shoot your Stars at him if you have any and
    avoid him jumping into you as well. Eventually you will defeat him

facts.subject: Room 23
facts.text: In Room 23, exit to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #23:
    Exit to the overworld.

facts.subject: Tetrad
facts.text: In the cave back in the overworld, go North to pick up another Tetrad and say the magic words 'PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW' to flip pages and send Mike to another time period.

evidence.quote:
Back in the overworld we are once again in the cave. Go North to 
    pick up another Tetrad. You say the magic words:
    PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW. 
    This flips the pages again and sends Mike to another time period.

facts.subject: stairs
facts.text: In Chapter 6: Venice, walk around the city to find an open door with a statue and paint with Zoda's footprints, then take the stairs down to enter the trap-filled first dungeon.

evidence.quote:
You start this chapter in the middle of a city that looks like 
    London from Chapter 4. You need to walk around the city for awhile 
    until you eventually find an open door. Enter the door to find a 
    statue and some paint spilled on the ground with Zoda's footprints 
    on the floor (uh-oh). You hear the statue so we can assume someone 
    is in the statue. Take the stairs down to enter the first dungeon 
    in this chapter. Since there are no enemies and only traps in
    this dungeon I won't detail it. Just pay attention to the traps
    and you should have no trouble reaching the room on the other side.

facts.subject: chisel and hammer
facts.text: In Da Vinci's room, grab the chisel and hammer, race back to chip Leonardo out of the statue, and receive his flying machine.

evidence.quote:
Back in the overworld we find ourself in Da Vinci's room. Grab the 
    chisel and hammer. Mike races back to the statue and chips Leonardo 
    out of the statue. He tells Mike that Zoda plastered him and offers
    Mike his flying machine. Mike takes the machine and flies it up in 
    the air when he gets another telepathic message from Mica. She tells 
    him to be careful and he tells her his adventure so far. As usual
    she leaves before Mike can say goodbye.

facts.subject: Small Island
facts.text: On Small Island, walk around the island to find a BIG HEART before heading back to the flying machine.

evidence.quote:
When we next see Mike he is on an island. There is a BIG HEART here 
    if you walk around the island. Once you get the BIG HEART head back 
    to the flying machine.

facts.subject: Museum Island
facts.text: Fly a little further in the flying machine and land on Museum Island to enter the Museum.

evidence.quote:
You will fly a little further and land on another island. You will 
    see a Museum here which you should enter.

facts.subject: Museum Floor 1
facts.text: Museum Floor 1 map displays Entrance O, dead ends XX, and stairways S1(UP) through S8(UP).

evidence.quote:
MUSEUM FLOOR 1
    ##############

    O = ENTRANCE
    XX = DEAD END

facts.subject: Museum Floor 2
facts.text: Museum Floor 2 map displays dead ends XX, down stairways S1(DN) through S8(DN), and Tetrad location $$.

evidence.quote:
MUSEUM FLOOR 2
    ##############

    XX = DEAD END
    $$ = Tetrad

facts.subject: Museum
facts.text: The museum is a large maze where you will occasionally fall through the floor into short one-room or larger dungeons that exit in adjacent rooms without a boss.

evidence.quote:
This museum is a large maze. You will occasionally fall through the 
    floor and they are short one room dungeons that have an exit in the 
    adjacent room. Some of them are larger but you don't have to worry
    about a boss at the end.

facts.subject: stairway S4(up)
facts.text: From the entrance of the museum, head North, take the right path curving East to stairway S4(up) to the second floor, then head West and follow the West path at the split to stairway S7(dn) leading back down.

evidence.quote:
When you first enter the museum head North and take the right path 
    to the North which will curve around to the East and eventually 
    take you to a stairway heading up. This is marked as S4(up) on the
    map I made. Once you make it to the second floor, head West instead 
    of North and you will curve around until you come to a split with 
    one path South and the other West. Continue on the West path and 
    you will eventually find a stairway back down marked as S7(dn) on
    the map I made.

facts.subject: stairway S8(up)
facts.text: From the statue room, head West for stairs S8(up) to the second floor, follow the middle path at the three-way split, and fall twice to face a triceratops at the end of both dungeons near the tetrad.

evidence.quote:
You are now in a room with statues and some stairs leading up a 
    little to the West. Head for those stairs marked as S8(up) on my
    map but anticipate falling a couple times before reaching them. 
    Eventually you will reach the stairway and head back up to the 
    second floor. Follow the path until it splits in three and take 
    the middle path. Once you get close to the tetrad you will 
    fall twice and face a triceratops at the end of both dungeons.

facts.subject: Tetrad
facts.text: Once you get the tetrad, Zoda appears and Mike is whisked off to the next time zone.

evidence.quote:
Once you get the tetrad Zoda will appear and you will be whisked 
    off to your next time zone.

LEGEND FOR SPOOKY CASTLE
    1 = Starting Point for Spooky Castle
    30 = BOSS: Zoda Y
    31 = Exit

facts.subject: Room 1

ROOM #1:

evidence.quote:

    There are two more hearts here if you need them. Otherwise head

ROOM #4:

ROOM #6-ROOM#9:
    These four rooms are connected. They each appear empty at first but

ROOM #21:

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22:

facts.text: In Room 28, defeat the magician to open the door North to Room 29.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #28:
    This room has a magician in it. Defeat him to open the door to the

facts.text: In Room 29, defeat the five bats to open the door North to Room 30, and activate several tiles to reveal two hearts and medicine.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #29:
    This room has five bats that once defeated will open the door to

facts.subject: Zoda Y
facts.text: In Room 30, shoot Zoda Y when he appears and avoid his spray of shots; when he transforms into a bird creature releasing two bats, avoid the feathers and being pushed into back wall spikes, and hit him until defeated to open the door East to Room 31.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #30: BOSS: Zoda Y
    When Zoda Y first appears he will appear, shoot a spray of shots at
    Mike and then disappear. Shoot at him when he first appears and
    then avoid his shots. Eventually you will defeat him and he will
    kneel down on one knee and transform into a bird creature. This
    form will release two bats at a time, you can defeat these bats if
    you'd like, but they will just keep coming as long as Zoda Y is
    still alive. The bord form will also flap its wings and push Mike
    back into spikes on the back wall. In addition to push Mike towards
    the spikes it will also release feathers at Mike that can damage
    him. Just keep hitting this bird form and you will eventually 
    defeat him to open the door to the East and ROOM #31.

facts.text: In Room 31, head North out of the room to get back to the Overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #31:

facts.text: In the overworld outside Spooky Castle, grab the tetrad and open the book to read PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW to flip pages and send Mike to another time period.

evidence.quote:
=============...SPOOKY CASTLE...=============
    We find Mike back in the overworld with another Tetrad in front of

    PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW.

_***You've got a Tetrad!  Your life level is increased!***_

facts.subject: Sir Lancelot
facts.text: In Chapter 8: Camelot, Mike finds himself in a forest and can talk to people like Sir Lancelot on the way to the castle.

evidence.quote:
||* 8: Chapter 8: CAMELOT *||
=============================

    We find Mike in the middle of a forest. After walking around you 
    will notice a castle in the distance. Talk to people like Sir 
    Lancelot on your way to the castle.

facts.subject: Arthur
facts.text: Inside the castle, Arthur asks for help with a dragon attacking Camelot; do not say NO, and after you accept, Arthur will increase your life and the guard blocking your path outside will move.

evidence.quote:
Inside the castle you will find 
    Arthur who will tell you that there is a dragon attacking Camelot. 
    He asks for your help. 
    * WARNING *
    Do not say NO, as this seems to prevent you from going any farther 
    in the game and you will need to reset. After you accept Arthur will 
    increase your life and when you go back outside the castle the guard 
    blocking your path will now move. Follow this path north until you 
    reach the cave.

facts.subject: Dragon Cave
facts.text: Dragon Cave starts at room 1, contains boss Knight at room 17, and exits at room 18.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR DRAGON CAVE
    1 = Starting Point for Dragon Cave
    17 = BOSS: Knight
    18 = Exit

evidence.quote:

    tile in the room but you will need to jump down to get the medicine 
    it reveals and then you will need to go around and back down to 
    this room. Otherwise head North to ROOM #6.

facts.subject: Room 3

evidence.quote:

    head West to ROOM #4.

facts.subject: Room 4

evidence.quote:

evidence.quote:

    it opens the wall to the East and ROOM #2.

facts.subject: Room 6

evidence.quote:

    through the floor to ROOM #8. There is also a medicine in this room 
    if you want to try to get it. You want to fall in the middle

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    If you landed on the ledge then simply head North to ROOM #13.

facts.text: In Room 9, avoid the several blue blobs and take the stairs up to Room 11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    There are several blue blobs in this room, but just avoid them and

facts.subject: Room 10
facts.text: In Room 10, avoid the several blue blobs and take the stairs up to Room 12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    There are several blue blobs in this room, but just avoid them and 
    head for the stairs which will take you up to ROOM #12.

facts.text: In Room 11, activate the tile to open the wall East back to Room 7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    Just activate the tile to open the wall to the East back to 
    ROOM #7.

facts.subject: Room 12
facts.text: In Room 12, activate the tile to open the wall West back to Room 7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12:
    Just activate the tile to open the wall to the West back to 
    ROOM #7.

facts.subject: Room 13
facts.text: In Room 13, defeat the two knights to open the wall West to Room 14.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    There are two knights in the room. Defeat them to open the wall to 
    the West and ROOM #14.

evidence.quote:
