facts.text: Tetrad items are found at the end of each chapter.

evidence.quote: Tetrad: These are found at the end of each chapter. Collect them all.

facts.subject: Axes
facts.text: You get Axes from a cave man named Tink in the Ice Age Chapter.

evidence.quote: Axes: You get these from a cave man named Tink in the Ice Age Chapter.

facts.subject: Daggers
facts.text: Daggers are an upgrade to axes, given by Cleopatra in Egypt Chapter.

evidence.quote: Daggers: An upgrade to your axes, given by Cleopatra in Egypt Chapter.

facts.subject: Katana
facts.text: The Katana is an upgrade to daggers, given by Leonardo Da Vinci in Venice.

evidence.quote: Katana: An upgrade to your daggers, given by Leonardo Da Vinci in Venice.

facts.subject: Psychic Shockwave
facts.text: A monkey in an Egyptian Savannah teaches Psychic Shockwave to Mike.

evidence.quote: Psychic Shockwave: A monkey in an Egyptian Savannah teaches this to you.

facts.subject: Super Psychic Shockwave
facts.text: A donkey in the Wild West teaches Super Psychic Shockwave to Mike.

evidence.quote: Super Psychic Shockwave: A donkey in the Wild West teaches this to you.

facts.subject: Ultra Psychic Shockwave
facts.text: Merlin in Camelot teaches Ultra Psychic Shockwave to Mike, which requires at least 10 hearts.

evidence.quote:
Ultra Psychic Shockwave: Merlin in Camelot teaches this to you. You will 
need at least 10 hearts to have this ability.

facts.subject: Rocks
facts.text: Rocks are the first weapon in the game, described as weak but useful, and are found in Ice Age.

evidence.quote:
Rocks: The first weapon in the game. Very weak but useful. Found in Ice 
Age.

facts.subject: Slingshot
facts.text: The slingshot is first found in Egypt and is more powerful than rocks.

evidence.quote:
Slingshot: A little more powerful than rocks and travels a little 
further.
The slingshot is first found in Egypt.

facts.subject: Spiked Frisbees
facts.text: Spiked Frisbees are found in Scotland Yard and shoot little frisbees a short distance.

evidence.quote:
Spiked Frisbees: Shoots little frisbees a short distance. Found in 
Scotland Yard.

facts.subject: Stars
facts.text: Stars are first found in Old West and inflict good damage.

evidence.quote:
Stars: Shoot these to inflict good damage. These are first found in Old 
West.

facts.subject: Spike Balls
facts.text: Spike Balls are first found in Transylvania and fire a spread shot in three directions.

evidence.quote:
Spike Balls: These do a spread shot in three directions. These are first
found in Transylvania.

facts.subject: BOARS
facts.text: BOARS are found in the caves of the Ice Age, requiring two hits with stones or one hit with the axe.

evidence.quote:
BOARS: One of the first enemies in the game. You first find these guys 
in the caves of the Ice Age. When you first meet them you have stones 
and they require to hits, but once you find the axe they can be taken 
out in one hit.

facts.subject: LIZARDS
facts.text: LIZARDS are found in the ICE AGE and require two hits of the axe.

evidence.quote:
LIZARDS: These guys are also found in the ICE AGE. They require two 
hits of the axe.

facts.subject: BLUE BEAR
facts.text: BLUE BEAR is found in the ice age and requires hits from the axe.

evidence.quote:
BLUE BEAR: FOund in the ice age. These guys require X number of hits 
from the axe.

facts.subject: YELLOW BEAR
facts.text: YELLOW BEAR is more powerful than the BLUE BEAR and requires more hits from the axe.

evidence.quote:
YELLOW BEAR: More powerful than the BLUE BEAR, these require even more 
hits from the axe.

facts.subject: SNOW MEN
facts.text: SNOW MEN are white and require several hits to defeat them.

evidence.quote:
SNOW MEN: I am not sure if they are snow men or not but they are white 
and require several hits to defeat them.

facts.subject: SPIDERS
facts.text: SPIDERS in Egyptian caves shoot little balls and are defeated with two hits from the axe.

evidence.quote:
SPIDERS: We first encounter these in the Egyptian caves. The can shoot 
little balls so watch out. Two hits from the axe will take them out.

facts.subject: CYCLOPS
facts.text: CYCLOPS carry daggers and are eliminated by a couple shots of the axe.

evidence.quote:
CYCLOPS: These guys carry daggers and attack similar to the BEARS. A 
couple shots of the axe they will be no more.

facts.subject: PORCUPINES
facts.text: PORCUPINES in Egypt are invincible once rolled into a ball and must be attacked when not rolled into a ball.

evidence.quote:
PORCUPINES: These creatures are invicible once they have rolled into a 
ball. You must attack them when they are not rolled into a ball. We 
first find them in Egypt.

facts.subject: SCORPIONS
facts.text: SCORPIONS in Egypt require two shots to defeat.

evidence.quote: SCORPIONS: Average enemeny you meet in Egypt. Just requires two shots.

facts.subject: UNDERGROUND ENEMY
facts.text: UNDERGROUND ENEMY is found in Egypt and their faces are never seen.

evidence.quote:
UNDERGROUND ENEMY: I am not sure if this is the best name for these 
guys. We never see their faces and find them in Egypt.

facts.subject: BLUE FROGS
facts.text: BLUE FROGS hop around and cause mischief but are easy to encounter.

evidence.quote:
BLUE FROGS: These guys can hop around and cause mischief but generally 
are easy to encounter.

facts.subject: CROCODILE
facts.text: CROCODILE enemies are long but slow and easy to defeat, similar to Lizards from the Ice Age.

evidence.quote:
CROCODILE: These are similar to the LIZARDS from the Ice Age. Long but 
slow and relatively easy to defeat.

facts.subject: WHITE JELLYFISH
facts.text: WHITE JELLYFISH levitate over the surface and are easy to defeat.

evidence.quote:
WHITE JELLYFISH: Somehow these jellyfish have acquired the ability to 
levitate over the surface. However, they are easy to defeat and 
shouldn't pose much problem.

facts.subject: HIPPOPATAMUS
facts.text: HIPPOPATAMUS hides in the water, pops its head up, and fires two shots.

evidence.quote:
HIPPOPATAMUS: These are generally hiding in the water when you first 
enter the room. They will pop their head up and fire two shots at you.

facts.subject: SWANS
facts.text: SWANS shoot at Mike once every few moments and require a few shots to defeat.

evidence.quote:
SWANS: Somehow these swans have the ability to shoot at you once every 
few moments. They are not very difficult but require a few shots to 
defeat.

facts.subject: LADYBUGS
facts.text: LADYBUGS wear skull masks and are defeated by a couple shots from the dagger.

evidence.quote:
LADYBUGS: I am not sure if they are ladybugs or not but their backs 
have colors similar to the ladybug. Their skull masks make them look 
frightening but a couple of shots from your dagger and they will be 
toast.

facts.subject: ASPS
facts.text: ASPS are snakes; do not get in the way of their charges.

evidence.quote:
ASPS: Similar to other snakes in the game. Just don't get in the way 
of their charges and you should be able to defeat them without much 
effort.

facts.subject: PYRAMID GUARDS
facts.text: PYRAMID GUARDS are slow and immune to daggers, requiring psychic shockwave to defeat.

evidence.quote:
PYRAMID GUARDS: They are slow but are immune to daggers. You need to 
use your psychic shockwave to defeat them.

facts.subject: AMAN-RA GUARDIAN
facts.text: AMAN-RA GUARDIAN slowly walks around and every once in awhile flashes and shoots two fireballs.

evidence.quote:
AMAN-RA GUARDIAN: I don't know if this is the best description for 
these guys but they remind me of the drwaings of Aman-Ra so I named 
them thus. They are moderately difficult to defeat. They just slowly 
walk around and every once in awhile flash and shoot two fireballs.

facts.subject: YELLOW JELLYFISH
facts.text: YELLOW JELLYFISH take twice as many shots to defeat as the White Jellyfish.

evidence.quote:
YELLOW JELLYFISH: Just like the White Jellyfish only they take twice 
as many shots to defeat.

facts.subject: RED FROGS
facts.text: RED FROGS take twice as many hits to defeat as Blue Frogs.

evidence.quote:
RED FROGS: These frogs are just like their Blue Frog ancestors only 
they take twice as many hits to defeat.

facts.subject: SMALL RATS
facts.text: SMALL RATS are similar to Boars or Scorpions and dangerous in numbers.

evidence.quote:
SMALL RATS: Similar to Boars or Scorpions. Just be careful of them in 
numbers.

facts.subject: LARGE RATS
facts.text: LARGE RATS take several hits to defeat and move around similar to Small Rats.

evidence.quote:
LARGE RATS: These guys take several hits to defeat but move around 
similar to the Small Rats.

facts.subject: BLUE BLOB
facts.text: BLUE BLOB jumps in the air and can generally only be hit when falling back to the ground.

evidence.quote:
BLUE BLOB: These are tricky to defeat because they jump in the air and 
you will generally only be able to hit them only when they fall back to 
the ground.

facts.subject: OWLS
facts.text: OWLS are always airborne, so attack them from a column or jump and attack them.

evidence.quote:
OWLS: These fly around similar to the jellyfish except you can hit the 
jellyfish at ground level. Owls are always airborn so either attack 
them from a cloumn or jump and attack them.

facts.subject: Zoda Spawn
facts.text: Zoda Spawn are little balls with tentacles from Zoda's ship in the first game.

evidence.quote: ZODA SPAWN: These are just little balls with tentacles. You'll remember...them from Zoda's ship in the first game.

facts.subject: Caterpillar
facts.text: Caterpillars look like floating caterpillars with glasses and occasionally spray three shots.

evidence.quote: CATERPILLAR: These guys look like floating caterpillars to me with...glasses. Like the kind from Alice in Wonderland. They will spray three...shots occasionally, but otherwise are easy to defeat.

facts.subject: Blue Scorpions
facts.text: Blue Scorpions can shoot two shots in one direction.

evidence.quote: BLUE SCORPIONS: This version of the scorpion can shoot two shots in one...direction.

facts.subject: Blue Asp
facts.text: Blue Asp is a big asp that takes several hits to defeat.

evidence.quote: BLUE ASP: Big asp that takes several hits to defeat.

facts.subject: Cactus Guys
facts.text: Cactus Guys should be defeated diagonally because they explode in a cross direction when defeated.

evidence.quote: CACTUS GUYS: These guys should be defeated diagonally because when you...defeat them they explode in a cross direction.

facts.subject: Treasure Chest
facts.text: Unfriendly treasure chests jump around and turn into coins when attacked.

evidence.quote: TREASURE CHEST: Not all treasure chests are friendly. You will see...some that jump around and turn into coins when they are attacked....These are moderately difficult.

facts.subject: Red Caterpillar
facts.text: Red Caterpillars take more hits and do more damage than other caterpillars.

evidence.quote: RED CATERPILLAR: Just like the other caterpillars only they take more...hits adn do more damage.

facts.subject: Blue Bats
facts.text: Blue Bats are found in Castle Dracula and take two hits to defeat.

evidence.quote: BLUE BATS: These are found in castle dracula and take two hits to...defeat.

facts.subject: Frankenstein
facts.text: Frankenstein creatures move slowly, but after a few hits their torso drops off into a faster pair of legs.

evidence.quote: FRANKENSTEIN: These are slow moving creatures but after a few hits...their torso drops off and they are a much faster pair of legs.

facts.subject: Ghosts
facts.text: Ghosts appear in groups, and the one that is a different color than the rest is the only one you can successfully hit.

evidence.quote: GHOSTS: These generally appear in groups. Look for the one that is a...different color than the rest as this will be the only one you can...successfully hit.

facts.subject: Tombstone Ghost
facts.text: Tombstone Ghosts can only be hit from behind in their tombstone and occasionally fire a shot at you.

evidence.quote: TOMBSTONE GHOST: These guys can only be hit from behind in their...tombstone. Occasionally they fire a shot at you.

facts.subject: Magician
facts.text: Magicians walk around leaving explosives that explode after a few moments.

evidence.quote: MAGICIAN: These guys walk around leaving explosives that explode after...a few moments. Avoid these and shoot at him when you get an opportunity.

facts.subject: Priests
facts.text: Priests leave bubbles that shoot back at you when hit, and priests usually hide behind them.

evidence.quote: PRIESTS: These guys leave bubbles like magicians except that they don't...explode. Instead when you accidentally (or intentionally) hit these...they shoot back at you. Priests will usually hide behind these as well.

facts.subject: Rock Guys
facts.text: Rock Guys take a couple hits and will explode.

evidence.quote: ROCK GUYS: These are similar ot the cactus guys from the Old West...chapter. A couple hits and they will explode so watch out when they do.

facts.subject: Purple Bats
facts.text: Purple Bats are an improved version of the original bats.

evidence.quote: PURPLE BATS: Just a more improved version of the original.

facts.subject: Big Green Blob
facts.text: Big Green Blob is slow to move and breaks up into small green blobs after enough hits.

evidence.quote: BIG GREEN BLOB: Slow to move, once you hit it enough it will break up...into small green blobs.

facts.subject: Small Green Blobs
facts.text: Small Green Blobs are a little harder to kill than their predecessors.

evidence.quote: SMALL GREEN BLOBS: Just your average garden variety blob. A little...harder to kill than their predecessors.

facts.subject: Knights
facts.text: Knights walk around at a moderate speed and occasionally shoot spikes in groups of three.

evidence.quote: KNIGHTS: These knights in shining armor walk around at a moderate speed....They occasionally will shoot spikes in groups of three.

facts.subject: Triceratops
facts.text: Triceratops takes a deep breath and shoots a big ball that you can jump over but cannot shoot through.

evidence.quote: TRICERATOPS: These guys take a deep breath and then shoot a big ball at...you. You can jump over it but cannot shoot through it.

facts.subject: Armored Knight
facts.text: Armored Knights carry a shield preventing hits from the front and must be hit from behind to defeat them.

evidence.quote: ARMORED KNIGHT: These guys move and shoot the same way as regular...knights. The difference is that these guys carry a shield preventing you...from hitting them in the front. Hit them from behind to defeat them.

facts.subject: Nile
facts.text: Traveling South along the Nile leads endlessly until you need to head back North, so head North.

evidence.quote:
There is paths leading North and South, but if you travel 
    South you will travel along the Nile endlessly and eventually need 
    to head back North again so just head North.

facts.subject: Guard
facts.text: Continuing North reveals a guard blocking your path, so head to the boat docked at the small oasis next.

evidence.quote:
Eventually you will come upon a small oasis with some people and a boat docked nearby. 
    If you continue North you will see a guard blocking your path, so 
    heading to the boat is what you want to do next.

facts.subject: Ship Guard
facts.text: If you try to enter the cabin before talking to everyone outside on the ship, the guard will not let you pass until you have talked with everyone outside.

evidence.quote:
If you enter the cabin before talking to 
    everyone outside on the ship the guard will not let you pass. Once 
    you have talked with everyone outside the ship he will let you 
    enter.

facts.subject: Cleopatra
facts.text: Cleopatra tells Mike she can help him search for the tetrads, but he must first get a pizza for her.

evidence.quote:
Inside you Mike meets with Cleopatra who asks his business 
    and he tells her he is searching for the tetrads. Cleopatra says 
    that she can help you but you must first get a pizza for her.

facts.subject: Ridge Cave
facts.text: After talking to Cleopatra, the person blocking the path lets you through to get pizza, and proceeding a little south leads to the cave.

evidence.quote:
Now that you 
    have talked to Cleopatra he will tell you this is the way to get 
    pizza and let you through. Proceed a little south and you will find 
    the cave.

facts.subject: Ridge Cave
facts.text: A map layout exists for Ridge Cave spanning Rooms 1 through 13.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR RIDGE CAVE
    1 = Starting Point for Yum Yum Cave
    12 = BOSS: Big Scorpion
    13 = Leads to Overworld

facts.subject: Room 1
facts.text: In Room 1, head North to Room 2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Just a usual entrance. Head North to ROOM #2.

facts.subject: Room 2
facts.text: In Room 2, defeat the three spiders and the East wall will open up allowing you to head to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    This room just has three spiders. Defeat them and the East wall 
    will open up allowing you to head to ROOM #3.

facts.subject: Room 3
facts.text: In Room 3, defeat the one cyclops and the East wall will open up allowing you to head to Room 4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There is one cyclops in here. Defeat him and the East wall will 
    open up allowing you to head to ROOM #4.

facts.subject: Slingshot
facts.text: In Room 4, jump on the tile for a question mark to appear, which opens the chest revealing a slingshot.

evidence.quote:
When you first enter you will see a tile and a treasure chest. 
    You must jump on this tile for a question mark to appear. Once 
    you get that question mark, then the chest will open revealing 
    a slingshot.

facts.subject: Room 4
facts.text: In Room 4, jump around avoiding spiders and take the path leading North.

evidence.quote:
Jump around this room carefully avoiding getting
    hit by the spiders and take the path leading North.

facts.subject: Room 5
facts.text: In Room 5, defeat the two porcupines to open the door and head North to Room 6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    There are two porcupines in here that you must defeat to open 
    the door and head North to ROOM #6.

facts.subject: Room 6
facts.text: In Room 6, defeat the three cyclops to open the door and head East to Room 7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    There are three cyclops in here that you must defeat to open 
    the door and head East to ROOM #7.

facts.subject: Room 7
facts.text: In Room 7, defeat the four scorpions to reveal a door to the East Room 8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    There are four scorpions in here that you must defeat to reveal 
    a door to the East ROOM #8.

facts.subject: Room 8
facts.text: In Room 8, defeat or avoid the four underground enemies and head to the East and Room 9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    There are four underground enemies in here that you can defeat 
    or simply avoid and head to the East and ROOM #9.

facts.subject: Room 9
facts.text: In Room 9, defeat the four underground enemies and two porcupines to open a door to the North and Room 10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    There are four underground enemies and two porcupines in here that 
    you must defeat to open a door to the North and ROOM #10.

facts.subject: Room 10
facts.text: In Room 10, which contains three spiders and two scorpions, hop up and around to go North to Room 11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    This room has three spiders and two scorpions who you don't have to 
    defeat but it is much easier to get through this room if you do. 
    You must hop up and around to go North to ROOM #11.

facts.subject: Room 11
facts.text: In Room 11, which has two porcupines and a couple spiders, make a couple jumps to reach the path North to Room 12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    There are two porcupines when you first enter the room, as well as 
    a couple more spiders...take you to ROOM #12.

facts.subject: Big Scorpion
facts.text: The Big Scorpion flashes red and shoots a spray of shots from his tail, which should be jumped over while keeping an eye on the little scorpions.

evidence.quote:
The big scorpion will flash red 
    and then shoot out a spray of shots from his tail. If you time it 
    right it should be easy to jump over his shots, just keep an eye on 
    the little scorpions.

facts.subject: Room 12
facts.text: Once Big Scorpion is defeated, the door opens to the West and Room 13.

evidence.quote:
Once he is defeated the door will open to the WEST and
    ROOM #13.

facts.subject: Room 13
facts.text: Room 13 is an exit leading North to the Overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    Just an exit. Head North to the Overworld.

facts.subject: Camel
facts.text: In the middle of the desert, you must rent a camel from the man to the East, as walking in any direction fails.

evidence.quote:
To his East is a man with a camel. Go over to him and he 
    will ask you if you want to rent a camel. You can say NO but if you 
    try to walk in any direction you will quickly see that you will need 
    to say YES to him.

facts.subject: Pizza
facts.text: After riding the camel for a very long time, you meet the pizza delivery guy who gives you the pizza.

evidence.quote:
You will then ride for a very long time until 
    eventually you spot what reminds me of a goomba on a koopa troopa 
    from Super Mario Bros. He informs you that he is the pizza delivery 
    guy and gives you the pizza.

Guy: Hey! You know the way to the Nile? I've got a special delivery. A large 
pizza with extra pepperoni for our best customers.
*You tell the story... Blah blah seeking pizza blah Cleopatra blah blah...
Guy: OK, I'll leave it up to you. Thanks a lot pal!
You've got the pizza.

facts.subject: Cleopatra
facts.text: After you give Cleopatra the pizza, she takes you across the Nile in her boat, drops you off on the shore, and tells you to head to the Pyramids to the South.

evidence.quote:
You hurry back to the boat and give Cleopatra the pizza...She will then take 
    you across the NIle in her boat and drop you off on the shore. She 
    will tell you to head to the Pyramids to the South.

Walk North and get on the barge.  Talk to everyone there and go inside.  The guard will let 
you pass, and you will get to talk to Cleopatra.  You tell her the story about the Tetrads, 
and she says that she can help you.  But first you have to retrieve a pizza for her.

Cleopatra Hmmmmmmm... I may be able to help you. I know of this tetrad and I 
could take you to it for a price. Do you like pizza? I love pizza. It's my 
favorite! I ordered a large pepperoni and it has taken way too long... It's 
been 3 days already! Why must they keep their Queen waiting? It makes me 
soooooo angry!! Bring me my pizza and I will take you to the tetrad and hold 
the anchovies, OK?

facts.subject: Dagger
facts.text: Cleopatra trades your axe for a dagger.

evidence.quote:
She also trades 
    your axe for a dagger.

facts.subject: Western side of the Nile
facts.text: On the western side of the Nile, head North until you find a small peninsula with some green patches, avoiding wandering West.

evidence.quote:
You are dropped off on the western side of the Nile. You can head 
    North or South but if you head West you will be wandering the desert 
    for ever. My suggestion would be to head North until you find a 
    small peninsula with some green patches.

facts.subject: Monkey Maze Part 1
facts.text: An ASCII map is provided for Monkey Maze Part 1 showing starting point O and exit X.

evidence.quote:
- - - M O N K E Y  M A Z E  P A R T # 1 - - -

             LEGEND FOR MONKEY MAZE PART #1
                       O = Starting Point
                       X = Exit

facts.subject: Monkey Maze Part 1
facts.text: In Monkey Maze Part 1, circle clockwise in the grass around the deck from below and left to the lower right hand side, then move up and down to the right and up the right side.

evidence.quote:
You will want to do a clockwise circle in the grass around 
    the deck. Where you start at the part of the grass below and to the 
    left from the initial deck and end up on the lower right hand side. 
    You then love up and down to the right and then up the right side. 
    You should come out of the grass near a BIG HEART.

facts.subject: Big Heart
facts.text: You can find a BIG HEART coming out of the grass in the Savannah before falling into a mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
You should come out of the grass near a BIG HEART. After just a few 
    step you will fall into a mini-dungeon

facts.subject: Savannah Dungeon A
facts.text: A map layout exists for Savannah Dungeon A spanning Rooms 1 through 6.

evidence.quote:
- - - S A V A N N A H  D U N G E O N   A - - -

                       LEGEND FOR SAVANNAH DUNGEON A
                       1 = Starting Point
             [6]       6 = Exit

facts.subject: Room 1
facts.text: In Savannah Dungeon A Room 1, there is nothing, so go to Room 2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Here you start. There is nothing here so go to ROOM #2.

facts.subject: Room 2
facts.text: In Room 2, there are three little frogs that you can kill or ignore, then head North to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are three little frogs. You can kill them or ignore them and 
    head NORTH to ROOM #3.

facts.subject: Room 3
facts.text: In Room 3, defeating the crocodile among three swans and a frog opens a door to the North to Room 4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are 3 swans here, a frog and a crocodile. Once the crocodile 
    is defeated a door to the North will open up to ROOM #4.

facts.subject: Hearts
facts.text: In Room 4, grab the two hearts on the island to your right, and then head West to Room 5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    In this room is a swan and two frogs. There are two hearts on the 
    island to your right. Grab them if you need them and then head West 
    to ROOM #5.

facts.subject: Room 5
facts.text: In Room 5, defeat the three floating jellyfish to open the wall to the North leading to Room 6, while the hippopotamus does not have to be killed.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    This room has 3 floating jellyfish. Take them out and the wall to 
    the North will open up allowing you to proceed to ROOM #6. There is 
    also a hippopotamus but you don't have to kill him to get to the 
    next room.

facts.subject: Room 6
facts.text: In Savannah Dungeon A, Room 6 is the exit back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    Exit back to overworld.

facts.subject: Monkey Maze Part 2
facts.text: Legend for Monkey Maze Part 2 shows starting point O, big heart HH, exit X, and dead end DE.

evidence.quote:
- - - M O N K E Y  M A Z E  P A R T # 2 - - -

             LEGEND FOR MONKEY MAZE PART #2
                       O = Starting Point
                      HH = BIG HEART
                       X = Exit
                      DE = Dead End

facts.subject: Big Heart
facts.text: In the Savannah, go around and pick up the BIG HEART on the shore to the East.

evidence.quote:
You will want to go around and pick up 
    that BIG HEART over on the shore to the East

facts.subject: Monkey Maze Part 2
facts.text: From the BIG HEART, backtrack up to the top East, back down to the left, and up and around the Western part of the map to fall into another dungeon.

evidence.quote:
back track 
    up to the top East, back down to the left, and then up and around
    the Western part of the map. You should come out of the grass 
    clearing and then randomly fall down into another dungeon.

facts.subject: Savannah Dungeon B
facts.text: A map layout exists for Savannah Dungeon B spanning Rooms 1 through 7.

evidence.quote:
- - - S A V A N N A H  D U N G E O N   B - - -

                       LEGEND FOR SAVANNAH DUNGEON B
                       1 = Starting Point
                       7 = Exit

facts.subject: Room 1
facts.text: In Savannah Dungeon B Room 1, there is nothing, so go to Room 2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Here you start. There is nothing here so go to ROOM #2.

facts.subject: Room 2
facts.text: In Room 2, kill the two crocodiles among two swans to open the door and head North to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    We encounter 2 crocodiles and 2 swans here. You only need to kill

facts.subject: half-way point

Luck Sign will basically give you unlimited tries.

and jump onto the platform when you see the raft coming.  The platform will disappear, so 
don't stand there waiting to die.

facts.subject: Bob's Store

evidence.quote:
Walk north till you find something that looks like a pile of garbage.  It's a town.  Talk to 
everybody outside, then head into the shop at the top of the screen.  Talk to the guy, then 
head out.  Now go to the right and around a house, and you'll see another guy that's sort of 
hidden there.  Talk to him too.  After you're finished with that, go into the saloon.  Talk 
to everyone there, and listen to the piano player's horrible song.  Once you've talked to 
everyone, go into Bob's Store, it'll be near the entrance to the town.  He'll give you a free 
pack of dynamite!

evidence.quote:
Go outside and run up to the West wall, in the mountain.  Place the 
dynamite inbetween the two rocks near the bottom (to place it, just walk up to the wall).  
The wall will explode, and walk inside to get a Big Heart.

In Chapter 5, before you enter any of the tunnels, if you
place a pack of dynamite at the end of the lower light-colored

the store for some extra points.

Notice the two lighter pathways at the side of the mountain?  
Place the dynamite 3 squares down from the lower one....Walk forward and you'll get into...

GOLD CAVE

some hearts hidden in some of those tiles.  Now, jump in the platform in the middle, and

facts.text: Jump across platforms past Fire Men, run by the next Grizzly in front of the open door, and defeat 3 Grizzlies in the following room.

evidence.quote:
YUM YUM'S CAVE

Go into the next room and kill the 4 boars.

jump across 
the platforms, passing by the Fire Men walking around...There is no point in defeating the 
next Grizzly, he doesn't open any secret doors, and the door is wide open behind him.  Just 
run by.  In the next room you'll face 3 more Grizzlies, so defeat them and move on.

facts.subject: Symbol Path
facts.text: Follow the path in the order Circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle to safely navigate without being taken out of the dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Follow the path to safety, the wrong 
way will take you out of the dungeon, and you'll have to start over.  In case you forgot, or 
are too lazy to scroll up, the order is: Circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, 
triangle.

facts.subject: YumYum
facts.text: Walk past the room filled with Fire Men and the next room with boars to reach the boss YumYum.

evidence.quote:
you'll get into another room filled with Fire Men.  
They don't give you anything, so just walk past them and out the door.  Same with the next 
room, the boars don't give you anything. Well that was fast!  In the next room you'll find 
the boss, YumYum.

facts.subject: Tetrad
facts.text: After YumYum is defeated, walk forward down the tunnel to find a Tetrad block that increases your life level.

evidence.quote:
When you're finished with him, walk forward down the tunnel and a bunch of kids will run at 
you...That's where 
you find some sort of weird block...You've got a Tetrad!  Your life level is increased!

facts.subject: Cleopatra
facts.text: Walk North, board the barge, and speak to Cleopatra, who asks you to retrieve a pizza for her.

evidence.quote:
Walk North and get on the barge.  Talk to everyone there and go inside.  The guard will let 
you pass, and you will get to talk to Cleopatra.  You tell her the story about the Tetrads, 
and she says that she can help you.  But first you have to retrieve a pizza for her.

facts.subject: Border Pass
facts.text: In Border Pass, kill the spiders in the first room and the Egyptian guy in the second room.

evidence.quote:
BORDER PASS

The first room will have a bunch of spiders in it, so kill em and move on.  Kill the Egyptian 
guy in the next room and continue to a room with platforms and spiders.

facts.subject: Slingshot
facts.text: Jump on the tile to get the orb that opens the chest, kill the spider, and collect the Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
Jump on the tile and 
get the orb thingy to open the chest.  Kill the spider and get the Slingshot, then kill the 
others and move into the next room.

facts.subject: Medicine
facts.text: Dodge hedgehogs, defeat 3 Egyptians and scorpions, then kill moving floor tiles to open a secret passage with medicine.

evidence.quote:
Dodge and kill the Hedgehogs, and follow the open 
doorway.  Great, more angry
Egyptians.  Get rid of all 3 and go into the next room.  The scorpions don't really do 
anything, so finish em off and keep going.  Kill the moving floor tile things and a secret 
opening should appear.  Get the medicine and go into the next room.

facts.subject: Giant Scorpion
facts.text: Follow the ledges across, defeat the spiders, and enter the boss room to face a giant scorpion.

evidence.quote:
Follow the ledges to the other side of the room and move on, 
but don't waste your time with the hedgehogs in the next room.  Kill the spiders and head 
over into the boss room, where you'll face a giant scorpion.

facts.subject: Caesar's Hut pizza
facts.text: Borrow a camel outside, ride to find the delivery boy riding a Koopa Troopa, and deliver Caesar's Hut pizza to Queen Cleopatra.

evidence.quote:
Head outside and you'll see a guy with a camel.  Talk to him and he'll lend you it, so hop on 
and ride baby ride!...After a long ride, you'll see a delivery boy riding a Koopa 
Troopa.  You tell him the story about seeking the pizza, and he gives it to you to give to 
the queen.  You hurry back and she finishes the wonderful Caesar's Hut pizza before it cools.

facts.subject: Bronze Dagger
facts.text: Cleopatra trades you her bronze dagger to face the dangers of the great pyramid.

evidence.quote:
I will trade you for my bronze dagger
_***You've got a dagger!***

facts.subject: The North
facts.text: From the left opening in The North, head 3 squares left, 7 squares up, 2 squares left, 3 squares up, 6 squares right, 3 squares down, 6 squares right, 5 squares down, 2 squares right, 4 squares up, 2 squares right, 4 squares down, 2 squares right, 11 squares up, 2 squares left, and 2 squares up into a mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Go to the left opening 
and head 3 squares left, 7 squares up, 2 squares left, 3 squares up, 6 squares right, 3 
squares down, 6 squares right, 5 squares down, 2 squares right, 4 squares up, 2 squares 
right, 4 squares down, 2 squares right, 11 squares up, 2 squares left, and 2 squares up.  Now 
you will fall into a mini-dungeon with awesome music.

facts.subject: The North
facts.text: Kill monkeys for hearts, kill the Croc in the next room to open the door, and kill the jellyfish in the third room to exit the mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Kill the monkeys and collect hearts from them if they give any...You only need to kill the Croc in the next 
room to open the door, so do so and get out.  Get the hearts if you need them and move on, 
here you need to kill the jellyfish to open the door.  And that's the end of this mini-
dungeon.

facts.subject: Big Heart
facts.text: Head through the left opening and walk 4 squares left, 10 squares up, 7 squares right, 6 squares down, 2 squares right, and down to get the big heart.

evidence.quote:
You should come out of the grass near a BIG HEART. After just a few 
    step you will fall into a mini-dungeon

You will want to go around and pick up 
    that BIG HEART over on the shore to the East

Head through the left and head 4 
squares left, 10 squares up, 7 squares right, 6 squares down, 2 squares right, and down to 
get the big heart.

facts.subject: The North
facts.text: From the big heart, go up 7 squares, left 3 squares, up 6 squares, left 6 squares, up 4 squares, left 1 square, up 4 squares, left 4 squares, down 4 squares, left 2 squares, up 5 squares, left 5 squares, down 1, and all the way left into another mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
From here go up 7 squares, left 3 squares, up 6 squares, left 6 squares, 
up 4 squares, left 1 square, up 4 squares, left 4 squares, down 4 squares, left 2 squares, up 
5 squares, left 5 squares, down 1, and all the way left into another mini-dungeon.

facts.subject: The North
facts.text: Kill the crocs and monkeys, kill all enemies in the next room, and jump to the ledge to run out of the room before the Hippo attacks.

evidence.quote:
Kill the crocs and go into the next room.  I suggest you kill the monkeys first, then head 
for the croc...You need to kill all the enemies in the 
next room, so do that and get out of there.  Just follow the path in here along into the next 
room.  Run to the right or left, and jump to the ledge.  Run out of the room before the Hippo 
attacks you.

facts.subject: The North
facts.text: Head 2 left, 2 down, left until you hit a wall, 4 down, 3 left, 1 down, 3 left, and far down till you hit a wall, then 1 square left, 4 squares down, 11 squares left, 3 squares up, 1 square left, 4 squares up, 5 squares right, 3 squares up, 6 squares left, 8 squares up, 3 squares right, 1 square down, 5 squares right, 3 squares up, around the bench, right 3 squares, up 3 squares, right 3 squares, and up.

evidence.quote:
Go to the left opening 
and head 3 squares left, 7 squares up, 2 squares left, 3 squares up, 6 squares right, 3 
squares down, 6 squares right, 5 squares down, 2 squares right, 4 squares up, 2 squares 
right, 4 squares down, 2 squares right, 11 squares up, 2 squares left, and 2 squares up.  Now 
you will fall into a mini-dungeon with awesome music.

From here go up 7 squares, left 3 squares, up 6 squares, left 6 squares, 
up 4 squares, left 1 square, up 4 squares, left 4 squares, down 4 squares, left 2 squares, up 
5 squares, left 5 squares, down 1, and all the way left into another mini-dungeon.

Kill the crocs and go into the next room.  I suggest you kill the monkeys first, then head 
for the croc...You need to kill all the enemies in the 
next room, so do that and get out of there.  Just follow the path in here along into the next 
room.  Run to the right or left, and jump to the ledge.  Run out of the room before the Hippo 
attacks you.

Head 2 left, 2 down, left until you hit a wall, 4 down, 3 left, 1 down, 3 left, and far down till you hit a wall.  Now 1 square left, 4 squares down, 
11 squares left, 3 squares up, 1 square left, 4 squares up, 5 squares right, 3 squares up, 6 
squares left, 8 squares up, 3 squares right, 1 square down, 5 squares right, 3 squares up, 
now go right and around the bench thing.  Go right 3 squares, up 3 squares, right 3 squares, 
and up to freedom!

facts.subject: Psychic Shockwave
facts.text: Reach the talking monkey to receive the power of the mind and learn the Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote:
You finally catch up with the monkey, who can talk!  He gives you the power of the mind, and 
you learn the Psychic Shockwave.

facts.subject: Great Pyramid
facts.text: In the Great Pyramid, jump on the middle tile on the left side of the room for hearts, then break the barrier with the Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote:
GREAT PYRAMID

Jump on the middle tile on the left side of the room for some hearts.  Walk forward and break 
that barrier with your new shockwave ability.

facts.subject: Great Pyramid
facts.text: Go up stairs past Cobras, jump the hole in the floor two steps past spikes, and hit the switch in the top left tile.

evidence.quote:
where you'll find some Cobras and stairs.  Go up the stairs.  Move with caution, as a wall of 
fire will appear when you're near the spikes.  Two steps past that, there is a hole in the 
floor, so be sure to jump over it.  Then there is another wall of fire.  The switch is in the 
top left tile.

facts.subject: Medicine
facts.text: Defeat two enemies with shockwave, defeat the mini-mummy and big mummy, press the switch in the top left tile, and jump on the platform to get medicine.

evidence.quote:
Use the shockwave to kill the two enemies 
and head upwards.  Quickly kill the mini-mummy and get the big guy.  The switch is in the top 
left tile.  Jump on the platform and get the medicine.

facts.subject: Great Pyramid
facts.text: Defeat the Horus enemy, fall through the hole in the middle of the tiles while heading sharply left for hearts, and hit the two switches located in the middle-left tile and bottom right.

evidence.quote:
GREAT PYRAMID

Jump on the middle tile on the left side of the room for some hearts.  Walk forward and break 
that barrier with your new shockwave ability.

where you'll find some Cobras and stairs.  Go up the stairs.  Move with caution, as a wall of 
fire will appear when you're near the spikes.  Two steps past that, there is a hole in the 
floor, so be sure to jump over it.  Then there is another wall of fire.  The switch is in the 
top left tile.

Kill the Horus-like enemy and head off.  There is a hole in the middle of the tiles.  As soon 
as you fall through it, head sharply to the left.  Get the hearts if you need them...There are two switches here, one in the middle-left tile, and one in 
the bottom right.  Get both and head out.

facts.subject: Try-Your-Luck sign
facts.text: Kill all enemies to get the Try-Your-Luck sign, defeat two Horus enemies, and defeat all tarantulas with shockwave to find hearts in the middle-upper-left tile of the midway room.

evidence.quote:
Kill all the enemies and get the Try-Your-Luck 
sign, then get the two Horus' in the next room.  You have to kill all the tarantulas in the 
next room, but make sure not to fall into the spikes.  Use the shockwave.  The next room is 
kind of the "midway" point.  There are some hearts in the middle-upper-left tile.

facts.subject: Flute
facts.text: Hit the switch on the tip of the tail in the snake tile room, get medicine from the right tile of the middle group, and defeat mini-mummies to hit the switch and pick up the Flute.

evidence.quote:
you'll find a room with 
a snake-like tile pattern.  The switch is on the tip of the tail.  Kill the two big mummies, 
and the Horus in the next room.  There will be a medicine in the right tile of the middle 
group.  In the next room there will be a lot of mini-mummies, so get in ready to fight.  Hit 
the switch and pick up the Flute.

facts.subject: Potion
facts.text: Use the flute in the room with the snake-like tile pattern to clear the way out, then cross the platforms in the mummy room to nab the potion.

evidence.quote:
When you get to the room with the snake-like tile pattern, use the flute, and your 
way out is shown clear.

Make it through to the room with all the mummies.  Follow the platforms across to the other 
side, and nab the potion.

facts.subject: Tetrad
facts.text: Defeat the boss in the final room of the Great Pyramid to claim the Tetrad and increase your life level.

evidence.quote:
When that's finished, walk forward and claim your prize...

_***You've got a Tetrad!  Your life level is increased!***

facts.subject: London
facts.text: After being jailed by a police officer, feel along the right wall to escape, pass through the crack in the wall, and walk between two buildings through a secret passage to reach the museum.

evidence.quote:
Follow the trail until you see a police 
officer.  Talk to him, and he'll put you in jail for being suspicious...Feel along the right wall till you find your escape 
route.  It won't be long until you reach a dead-end, but you should know that little crack in 
the wall seems out of place.  Walk in between the two buildings, you'll find another secret 
passage.  Now just walk until you reach the museum

facts.subject: Zoda-X
facts.text: Meet Sherlock Holmes at the museum where Zoda-X escapes with the Tetrad stone.

evidence.quote:
Aha!  Just in time, Wats...er...Mike.  Come, I will show you the stone_
_*A Tetrad!*_
_*Quickly, you reach for it*_
_*But suddenly...*_

_Ha!  Ha!  I've got the Tetrad now, Mike!_...Zoda-X has escaped with the Tetrad!

facts.subject: Rocks
facts.text: Go north from the room where you land to grab the rocks in the top-right corner.

evidence.quote: Go north from the room where you land, grab the rocks in the top-right corner, and kill the two creatures to open a secret door to the west.

facts.subject: Secret door
facts.text: Kill the two creatures to open a secret door to the west.

evidence.quote: kill the two creatures to open a secret door to the west.

facts.subject: Polar bear
facts.text: Kill the polar bear to open the secret door to the north, which leads to a staircase going back to the surface.

evidence.quote: Kill the polar bear there to open the secret door to the north. Go through that and you see the staircase going back to the surface.

facts.subject: Hearts
facts.text: Go into the room north of where you get the rocks if you need hearts.

evidence.quote: If you need hearts, go into the room north of where you get the rocks.

facts.subject: Rocks
facts.text: The throwing range of the rocks is VERY limited, so be careful.

evidence.quote: Please note the throwing range of the rocks is VERY limited, so be careful.

facts.subject: Tink
facts.text: One of the cave people, named Tink, will give you an Axe, your first regular weapon.

evidence.quote: One of the cave people, named Tink, will give you a Axe, your first regular weapon.
Tink: I'm Tink. I make tools from bones and stones. Mike, try using my axe!...You've got an axe!

facts.subject: Yum-Yum
facts.text: The leader begs you to defeat Yum-Yum, who can be found by taking the western exit from the cave and heading north.

evidence.quote: The leader tells you that you must be the 'reliever' to come help these people. He tells you Yum-Yum killed a lot of people and begs you to defeat him. The monster can be found to the north. Take the western exit from the cave and head north to find Yum-Yum's cave.

facts.subject: Medicine
facts.text: Find the medicine in the secret room near the start of Yum-Yum's Cave.

evidence.quote: Find the medicine in the secret room near the start.

facts.subject: Pillars puzzle
facts.text: In the room with the three shapes on the pillars, walk in the order: Circle, Circle, Triangle, Square, Circle, Square, Triangle.

evidence.quote: When you come to the room with the three shapes on the pillars, you must walk in the direction indicated by the paintings of Pikzao that you saw in the cave....Just in case you forgot to write the order down, it goes -- Circle, Circle, Triangle, Square, Circle, Square, Triangle.

facts.subject: Yum-Yum
facts.text: Do not kill the hog in front of Yum-Yum or he will attack much faster and harder, making him much tougher to defeat.

evidence.quote: Do NOT kill the hog he has in front of him or he will attack much faster and harder, making him much tougher to defeat.

facts.subject: Yum-Yum
facts.text: Stay in the back and dodge bubbles when Yum-Yum is in the back row, then charge forward, jump over his bubbles, and fire axes at him when he moves to the front.

evidence.quote:
Name: Yum Yum
Area: Yum Yum's Cave...As soon as you get in the room, walk up to him and attack.
He...won't attack you until he eats the Wild Boar on his plate.
Do NOT kill the hog he has in front of him or he will attack much faster and harder, making him much tougher to defeat.
You can't hit him in the back row, so just stay in the back and dodge bubbles. When he moves to the front, charge forward and jump over his bubbles, firing axes at him all the time.

facts.subject: Tetrad
facts.text: After discovering the four missing people in the cave past Yum-Yum, head north to find a Block that is one of the missing Tetrads.

evidence.quote: Upon arriving at the next cave, you discover the four missing people, including Shorty, Pikzao's son!...After they leave, head north and find a Block....After she's finished, Mike figures out the block he found is one of the missing Tetrads.

facts.subject: Queen Cleopatra
facts.text: Queen Cleopatra sends Mike out to get a pizza for her in return for promising to help find another Tetrad.

evidence.quote: Talk to MORE people, and find Queen Cleopatra. She sends Mike out to get a pizza for her....In return for bringing her her pizza, Celopatra promises to help you find another one of the Tetrads.

facts.subject: Slingshot
facts.text: In the room with the chest, jump on the tile on the ground to open the chest and get the slingshot weapon.

evidence.quote:
Jump on the tile and 
get the orb thingy to open the chest.  Kill the spider and get the Slingshot, then kill the 
others and move into the next room.
In the room with the chest, you will see a title on the ground. Jump on it, don't step on it, and that will open the chest and give you a weapon, the slingshot.

facts.subject: Porcupines
facts.text: Porcupines change into a ball and charge, so position yourself to the left or right of where they stop at a wall and nail them before they can change again.

evidence.quote: The porcupines have the ability to change into a ball and charge at you. Get out of their way when they do. They always stop at a wall, so position yourself to the left or right of where they will stop and nail them before they can change again.

facts.subject: Medicine
facts.text: Clear all the enemies from all the rooms to open secret rooms, one of which contains medicine that can be collected again if you die.

evidence.quote:
Dodge and kill the Hedgehogs, and follow the open 
doorway.  Great, more angry
Egyptians.  Get rid of all 3 and go into the next room.  The scorpions don't really do 
anything, so finish em off and keep going.  Kill the moving floor tile things and a secret 
opening should appear.  Get the medicine and go into the next room.
clear all the enemies from all the rooms the first time through so you can open secret rooms. In one of them you find some medicine....In case you die here, you can get the medicine again.

facts.subject: Giant Scorpion
facts.text: When fighting the Giant Scorpion, defeat small scorpions from the two holes if they get close, use the slingshot from afar, and move or jump when he flashes and makes noise to fire bullets.

evidence.quote:
Name: Giant Scorpion
Area: Border Pass...Just run up to him and attack.  After a couple of seconds he'll shoot a spread of 
tiny...fireballs/bullets/pebbles...Avoid the scorpion enemies

There's two holes in the wall above the overgrown stinger, from which small scorpions will come out from time to time. Defeat these if they get close to you and try to focus most of your attention on the big bug. Use the slingshot if you still have it, as it's range is longer....Every now and then he will flash and make noise -- that means he's getting ready to fire a spread of bullets. Stay as far away from him as possible and hit him repeatedly with your weapon. When he flashes, get ready to either move out of the way or jump.

facts.subject: Mike
facts.text: In the large desert east of the cave, talk to the man and rent his camel to get the pizza.

evidence.quote:
When you come out of the cave, you'll be in a large desert.  Head east and you 
will spot a man, a camel, and a oasis.  Talk to the man and rent his camel so 
you can get the pizza.

facts.subject: Cleopatra
facts.text: After the queen finishes the pizza, her barge sets sail across the river, she reveals a pyramid to the south contains the Tetrad, and trades your stone age axe for a bronze dagger.

evidence.quote:
After the queen is finished eating the entire pizza (man, I can't even do 
that!) she has the barge set sail and cross the river.  Cleopatra tells you 
there is a pyramid to the south, and inside you will find the Tetrad.  She'll 
also trade your stone age axe for a bronze dagger.

facts.subject: Pyramid
facts.text: In the first room of the pyramid, step on the center title in the western group to get some hearts.

evidence.quote: Head south, following the desert path, and you'll come to the pyramid.  Step on the center title in the western group in the first room to get some hearts.

facts.subject: Energy barrier
facts.text: The next room inside the pyramid has an energy barrier with no way through, prompting you to go back outside and talk to two men.

evidence.quote:
In the next room, though, 
you find a energy barrier with no way to get through it.  So head back outside 
again and talk to the two men who are now there.

facts.subject: Grass Field
facts.text: A heart container is located in the eastern part of the Grass Field maze.

evidence.quote:
Don't miss the heart 
container that is the eastern part of the maze.

facts.subject: Magician
facts.text: Exiting the maze to the north leads outside to the man, who grants you the psychic shock wave to attack enemies and destroy barriers before warping you back to the pyramid.

evidence.quote:
Finally you exit the maze 
to the north and go outside again, where the man comes down to talk to you.  He 
gives you the ability of the psychic shock wave, a mental attack that can be 
used on enemies and grows stronger as you do.  He says it can also be used to 
destroy barriers.  Then he warps you back to the pyramid.

facts.subject: Pyramid
facts.text: In the room with a circle of titles, stepping in the center causes a pitfall; hold left or right on the pad while falling to land safely in the next room.

evidence.quote:
In another room with a 
circle of titles you need to step in the center, and you will fall down a pit.  
Hold left or right on the pad as you fall and you will land allright in the next 
room, otherwise, you fall into another room.

facts.subject: Flute
facts.text: Inside the pyramid, pick up the magical flute and blow it in subsequent rooms; in one room, three snakes emerge from the west wall, which open the correct passage when defeated.

evidence.quote:
You also pick up a magical item, the flute.  Blow it in all 
the rooms you come to after you get it and in one three snakes will come out of 
the west wall.  Defeat them to open the correct passage to proceed.

facts.subject: Medicine
facts.text: There are a total of three medicines to be found inside the pyramid.

evidence.quote:
There is a 
total of three medicines to be found so be careful.

facts.subject: Monster Mask
facts.text: Against Monster Mask, stay close to the wall moving against arrows, hit him constantly with daggers from one side to the other, and avoid getting in front of his fatal mouth energy blast.

evidence.quote:
Name: Monster Mask
Area: Great Pyramid...attack using the Shockwave.  After some damage is dealt, Monster Mask will 
go red and...move faster.

When he's close to you, however, he stops, his eyes open wide, and he fired a 
powerful energy blast from his mouth.  You can only take one hit from this 
before you die, so be careful NOT to get hit with it!...Just stay 
close to the wall, moving against the arrows, and hit him constantly with your 
daggers from one side to the other.  Never get in the center of him or risk 
facing a attack from his mouth.

facts.subject: Tetrad
facts.text: Defeating Monster Mask allows you to leave the pyramid and enter a small room containing the Tetrad.

evidence.quote:
Keep up 
the heat and soon he'll be dead and you can head out of the pyramid.  Then 
you'll be in a small room in which you find the Tetrad.

facts.subject: Jail Cell
facts.text: If thrown in jail by the police officer, press against a section of the eastern wall of your cell to escape.

evidence.quote:
If you talk to 
the police officer, he throws you in jail.  Press against a section of the 
eastern wall of your cell to get out.

facts.subject: Manhole
facts.text: Outside after the museum encounter, head down the manholes to your left first to find a heart container.

evidence.quote:
When you find yourself outside again, head down the manholes to your left first 
to find a heart container.

facts.subject: Sewer
facts.text: There is one medicine that can be found down in the first sewer area.

evidence.quote:
There is one medicine that 
can be found down here in the sewers.

facts.subject: Zoda's Creature
facts.text: To fight Zoda's Creature, go to the top-right platform, jump between the appearing rafts throwing daggers, and return to dry land to repeat.

evidence.quote:
Name: Zoda's Creature
Area: Sewer...You have to jump from platform to platform, stopping briefly to throw in a few 
attacks.

You need to go up to the top-right platform and jump for the first raft.  Then 
you need to jump around on the rafts that pop up, one after another, until after 
the last one you jump back to dry land, go back to the platform, and repeat.  
You only have time on each raft to throw a couple daggers before you need to 
move.

facts.subject: Sewer, Part II
facts.text: In Sewer, Part II, there are four medicines to be found across hidden rooms and title pit drops, along with throwing stars in two locations.

evidence.quote:
Not very far in you'll find a secret room 
where you can get some medicine....You will 
find yet another medicine for a total of four in this stage, plus some throwing 
stars in two locations.

facts.subject: Sewer, Part II
facts.text: In the room with three groups of titles, fall down the center of the left group first, then the right one, and finally the center group to reach the level below.

evidence.quote:
There are three 
groups of titles here -- walking into the center of one of the groups causes you 
to fall down to the level below.  Fall down the left one first, then the right 
one, and finally the center.

facts.subject: Zoda
facts.text: Against Zoda, jump over or dodge his bullet spread at close range, or carefully avoid/stay in the center of the three or four blue fires he fires when far away.

evidence.quote:
Depending on how far away you are from him determines 
his attack -- if you're close, it's a spread of bullets that must be jumped over 
or dodged.  If you're far away, he fires three or four blue fires that spring up 
in the area around Mike, and you either have to stay in the center till it fades 
or very carefully get out of them.

facts.subject: Sewer, Part II
facts.text: After defeating Zoda, head north into the sewers to pick up the dropped Tetrad.

evidence.quote:
Head north to exit.

Back in the sewers again you'll find the stolen Tetrad that Zoda had dropped 
after his defeat.

facts.subject: Store
facts.text: In the Old West town, talk to the store owner to receive dynamite for blasting through rock walls.

evidence.quote:
Go to the store and talk to the 
owner, and he gives you some dynamite.

facts.subject: Mountain side
facts.text: Bomb the spot between two small boulders in the southern part of the mountain wall to find a heart container.

evidence.quote:
Down in the southern part of the mountain wall 
there are two small boulders.  Bomb the spot in between them and you'll find a 
heart container.

facts.subject: Mountain side
facts.text: Gold nuggets can be found by blasting the cave where the colored rock trail ends, bombing two spaces north of the northern colored cave, and bombing the southernmost part of the wall.

evidence.quote:
